description:
Descrição

Executar a manutenção elétrica preventiva e corretiva em motores, máquinas, bombas, equipamentos e instalações operacionais, de forma a mantê-los em perfeitas condições de uso.

Orientar os usuários sobre as condições de funcionamento e operação dos equipamentos elétricos, visando otimizar o desempenho desses equipamentos e evitar paradas por quebra ou defeito. Requisitos e qualificações

Ensino Médio Completo; Curso em Elétrica, eletrotécnica ou Eletrônica.

Experiência: Função anterior como Eletricista

title: Senior Staff / Principal Engineer - Digital Ecosystem
description:
We are hiring a Senior Staff or Principal Engineer to support driving the technical vision and execution for Nubank’s Digital Ecosystem division, with initial focus on NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance. This is a division‑level leadership role: you will work with exceptional engineers (including staff engineers), lead cross‑org architectural decisions, negotiate trade‑offs with product/finance/legal, and enable scalable delivery of high‑impact products (checkout & wallet, advertiser platform and benefits hub, and 1‑click insurance products).

2026's vision and (how this role contributes)

In 2026 we will transform the Digital Ecosystem into a place where customers discover advantages, pay effortlessly and feel protected, and where merchants grow through data‑driven integrated partnerships. Our priorities are: (1) elevating app quality, (2) deepening customer engagement with contextual and personalized experiences , (3) making Nubank the preferred payments partner and growth engine for merchants , and (4) ensuring scalable, compliant, and financially healthy foundations . This role will own the technical plan to deliver that vision across NuPay, Ads & Rewards and Insurance .

Mission design and operationalize the 2–3 year technical end‑state for the Digital Ecosystem so that:

  • NuPay scales to become the de facto checkout and wallet for Nubank customers (TPV ×2 by Dec/26; wallet >3M MAU),
  • Ads & Rewards delivers the Advantages Tab, a performant advertiser platform and Ads POC with merchants, and drives material ecosystem revenue,
  • Insurance launches and scales high‑quality one‑click complements (Mobile Insurance Relaunch, Pix Protegido evolution), while maintaining aggressive SLOs, strong observability, controlled TCO and an elevated engineering culture.

Core responsibilities

  • Support defining the division’s technical end‑state (2–3 years): architecture, shard/partition strategy, migration path (one‑stack) and explicit trade‑offs (cost × latency × availability).
  • Co‑own availability and performance: set SLIs/SLOs, error budgets, runbooks, incident playbooks and an observability strategy that supports merchants with strict SLAs.
  • Support Ads & Rewards platform design: advertiser platform (audience & campaign management), decision/bidding service, real‑time vs batch decisioning, measurement & attribution (ROAS/incrementality), and minimise impact on app UX.
  • Enable Insurance delivery: technical enablement for one‑click products, partner integration and governance (e.g., Chubb), migration to subscription/billing platform where applicable, and app quality improvements (TTFD, dashboards, NPS).
  • Support one‑stack discovery and phased migration: balance platformization with pragmatic delivery and tech‑debt management to avoid blocking growth.
  • Catalyse product quality culture: introduce and operationalize Product Quality Reviews, drive app excellence rituals, and ensure UX/technical quality are considered across the product lifecycle.
  • Mentor and grow engineering leaders and staff engineers; run RFCs, tech talks and post‑mortems; design career paths and enable managers to deliver cross‑BU initiatives.
  • Represent the division in cross‑org negotiations and external partner discussions (merchants, partners, regulators), aligning stakeholders and escalating risks proactively.
  • Track and report technical impact against business metrics and engineering health indicators.

Key business & engineering metrics you will influence

  • NuPay: TPV growth (2× by Dec/26), wallet MAU (>3M), share‑of‑checkout (SoC), p99 latency and availability for merchant traffic.
  • Ads & Rewards: ad revenue targets (material ecosystem revenue), ROAS / iROAS / incrementality, CTR, Ads POC results (≥2 merchants), Advantages Tab / Shelves Platform launch.
  • Insurance: one‑click complements GWP target (R$493M EOY), product NPS (>60 targets), churn reduction via billing/tolerance changes.
  • Engineering health: Engineering Stability Index (ESI), App Quality Score, incident frequency/severity, time to integrate new partners.

Challenges and opportunities (what you’ll own)

  • World‑class app quality & Magic App MVP: raise engineering and product expectations, and deliver first‑layer Magic App experiences (Advantages Tab, widgets, contextual flows such as AIPB).
  • Real‑time decisioning and aspirational financing: enable low‑latency ads decisioning and NuPay real‑time underwriting for extended financing while preserving app performance.
  • One‑click Insurance at scale: deliver MIR (no IMEI) and Pix Protegido evolution, dedicating energy to one‑click complements and partnering with Chubb while retaining monitoring/control.
  • Capture offline transactions: accelerate NuPay NFC wallet adoption as an offensive play to reach ~3M MAU and increase offline SoC.
  • Platform & compliance foundations: complete SPB integration, advance One‑Stack Project, meet Magic App and regulatory mandates, and ensure resilient, cost‑effective infra.

What you’ll find in the team

  • High‑calibre engineers, including staff engineers and experienced engineering managers.
  • Complex, high‑impact problems at scale: large merchant integrations, real‑time decisioning, strict SLOs and multi‑partner dependencies.
  • Autonomy to shape architecture, product quality rituals and the division roadmap, plus the responsibility to align delivery across product, infra, legal and commercial stakeholders.

What you’ll navigate

  • Heavy cross‑BU dependencies (Global Platforms, Nubank+, UV, Marketing) requiring strong stakeholder orchestration.
  • Regulatory changes (SPB/BCB) that may force re‑architecture or open‑scheme decisions.
  • Dependence on third‑party vendors (wallet SDKs, insurance partners) and partner infra limitations.
  • Balancing rapid commercialization and monetization with fraud/credit loss control and sustainable unit economics.
  • Trade‑offs between accelerating one‑stack migration and accepting short‑term technical debt to preserve delivery velocity.

title: Lead Software Engineer / Tech Lead Manager, Growth (Remote)
description:
Fully Remote (North America / South America)

  • There is 1 opening, posted to multiple locations.

No agencies.

About Maximus

Maximus ( is a mission-driven consumer performance medicine telehealth company that provides men and women with content, community, and clinical support to optimize their health, wellness, and hormones. Maximus has achieved profitability, 8-figure ARR, and is doubling year over year - with a strong cash position. We have raised $15M from top Silicon Valley VCs such as Founders Fund and 8VC as well as leading angel investors/operators from companies like Bulletproof, Tinder, Coinbase, Daily Stoic, & Shopify.

We also offer Maximus Labs, a standalone biomarker testing subscription that doubles as an acquisition channel into our telemedicine protocols. We're targeting 2x customer growth this year and need a Growth Lead who can build the acquisition engine that gets us there.

We're capital-efficient and compete against Hims, Hone, Keeps, and Fella by being better at the product, not louder with ad spend. Our growth strategy is conversion-driven: make the signup-to-checkout funnel so good that paid channels become more efficient by default.

About the Role

We are looking for a strong Lead Engineer (Tech Lead) to lead our Growth engineering team. You will be splitting your time roughly 50/50 between management and coding. You own the lower acquisition funnel, from flow start through checkout, across all Maximus protocols.

Your north star metric is Flow Start to Checkout CVR. You also carry an M1 Retention guardrail, which means you can't optimize for conversion at the expense of user quality. Every experiment you ship has a built-in quality check.

You will manage a small team of engineers and work directly with a Sr. PM and Sr. Designer. You will report directly to the Head of Engineering.

Why this role and join us?:

  • Impact: Set the technical direction for how Maximus acquires customers, run experiments that directly move revenue, and build a team that compounds learning over time. The Growth team's output is visible in the company's top-line numbers every month.

  • First 90 days: Complete BNPL migration to Klarna across all protocols

  • First 2 Quarters: Launch a new activation satisfaction survey for our retention guardrail and build cohort-level experiment tracking

  • Maximus is at the stage where the acquisition engine needs a dedicated engineering leader who stays with the problem long enough to compound results. If you want to own that end to end, with real authority and real accountability, this is the role for you.

What you will do (Key Responsibilities):

  • Deliver protocol-level A/B experiments on signup flows, checkout, plan pricing, and product recommendations using Amplitude
  • Ship full-stack features across the acquisition funnel in Rails and React
  • Coach and develop your engineering team through regular 1:1s, pair programming, code reviews, and career conversations
  • Own experiment design, including sample sizing, metric selection, and the CVR-vs-retention tension that comes with a dual mandate
  • Iterate and continuously optimize plan and pricing architecture, including payment platform integrations
  • Build and maintain the experimentation infrastructure your team runs on
  • Partner with data engineering to instrument cohort-level M1 retention tracking per experiment
  • Drive adoption of AI-assisted development across the team, using tools like Claude Code and Devin to increase shipping and development velocity

Our Tech Stack:

  • Ruby on Rails 7 / Ruby 3.3, React 18 / TypeScript 5.4 (strongly preferred)
  • Event-sourced architecture with command pattern
  • PostgreSQL, Redis, Delayed Job for background processing
  • Stripe and Klarna for payments and installment plans
  • Amplitude for experimentation and analytics, Segment for event collection
  • Redux with redux-loop and Immutable.js on the frontend
  • Docker, AWS/GCP, Aptible, GitHub Actions CI/CD
  • Cypress for E2E testing
  • AI-assisted development: Claude Code and Devin for agentic coding

What we are looking for (Qualifications):

  • You've led a team of 4-8 engineers before, with direct reports you grew and retained
  • You've shipped and measured growth experiments in a subscription product (signup funnels, checkout optimization, pricing and plan architecture)
  • You write production Ruby on Rails and React code and expect to keep doing so (strongly preferred). Javascript (Node), Python are also acceptable.
  • You can design an experiment, pick the right metric, set a sample size, and explain the trade-offs to a PM who wants to ship faster
  • You think in funnels and cohorts, not just features
  • You're comfortable with event-sourced systems or similar architectural patterns where state is derived from event streams
  • You use agentic AI coding tools (Claude Code, Devin, Cursor, or similar) in your daily workflow and have opinions about how to integrate them into a team's development process

Nice to have (strongly preferred):

  • Experience with healthcare, wellness, or regulated subscription commerce
  • Familiarity with Stripe billing, Klarna, or similar payment platform integrations
  • Experience building or managing Amplitude (or LaunchDarkly, Optimizely, etc.) experimentation infrastructure

How we work:

  • Remote, Americas-based (team is distributed across US and Latin America time zones)
  • Two-week sprints with PM, Design, and Tech Lead driving prioritization together
  • Ship and deploy to production multiple times per day

World-Class Benefits:

  • Full suite: health, medical, dental coverage (USA & Canada)
  • Flexible vacation/time-off policies
  • Equity into the company in the form of high potential stock options
  • Liquidity of options whenever available
  • Extended options exercise window for loyal employees (3 months for every year of service; e.g. 1 year for 4+ year employees)

Interview process

Do you believe you're a fit for this role and want to join the Maximus team? We'd love to hear about you! Here is what you can expect from the hiring process (if there are changes we will be sure to let you know).

Please refrain from messaging or emailing people directly, if you are interested, apply directly, your application will be reviewed by a human.

  1. Application & Criteria Questionnaire: When submitting your application and resume, tell us why you want to join Maximus and take your time with the questions. The Criteria Questionnaire will be sent to you automatically and is mandatory, we will use it as part of our data driven process. This is your chance to make a strong first impression.
  2. First Interview (30min): Interview with Justin L, Recruiting Lead. This will be a exploratory conversation focused on how you work, your experience & fit for the role, and alignment on values and expectations.
  3. Hiring Manager Interview (60min): You will then meet with Mark P - Head of Engineering to understand how you would approach real Growth team problems across system design and technical decisions as well as discussion about leading a team, growing engineers, hiring, AI adoption, and other aspects of people leadership.
  4. Technical Interview (60min): Interview with one of our Senior or Lead engineers to evaluate hands-on coding ability in our stack (Rails + React/TypeScript). We want to see that you can build and ship, not just architect. Feel free use agentic AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf, etc.) during the exercise, as appropriate.
  5. Product Interview (45min): You will chat with Steve C - Senior Growth Product Manager who will dive into your collaboration with product, how you assess tradeoffs, and growth related product work.
  6. Meet the CEO (30min): At the very end, you will have the opportunity to meet with Cam S, our CEO. This is a great chance for you to gain a deeper understanding of Maximus's strategy, values, and work processes.

Maximus is an equal opportunity employer, which not only includes standard protected categories, but the additional freedom from discrimination against your free speech and beliefs, as long as they are aligned with company values. We celebrate intellectual diversity.

Note: We utilize AI note-taking technology during our interview sessions to ensure we capture all answers and details accurately. Candidates are also encouraged to use AI note-takers for their own records if they wish.

title: Engineer - Pipe System Design
description:
Subsea Flexible Pipe System Design Engineer

At NOV Subsea Production Systems (NOV SPS), part of the Fortune 500 company NOV, we power the industries that power the world. Our core business is engineering, manufacturing, and delivering high-quality flexible pipe systems for offshore oil and gas developments around the globe.

NOV SPS designs and manufactures flexible pipes and innovative subsea solutions for the offshore energy industry. With operations in Denmark (Brøndby and Kalundborg) and Brazil (Rio de Janeiro and Açu Port), we combine advanced engineering expertise with state‑of‑the‑art manufacturing technology to deliver subsea equipment to major oil companies and installation contractors worldwide.

As demand for offshore flexible pipe systems continues to grow, we are looking for talented Pipe System Design Engineers to join our global engineering team in Rio de Janeiro or Açu Port, Brazil.

Your New Role

As part of the Pipe System Design Engineering department, you will play a key role in front‑end project phases, including tenders, FEED studies, and new product development.

You will contribute to concept definition, preliminary design, and early‑stage technical evaluations that directly influence project direction and product innovation. Depending on your background and business needs, you may work with flexible riser system analysis or flexible pipe cross‑section design.

Working in a multidisciplinary and international environment, you will collaborate closely with engineering, manufacturing, project management, and commercial teams to develop robust, fit‑for‑purpose, and cost‑effective subsea solutions—driven by a continuous improvement mindset and a focus on advancing technical boundaries.

Your Responsibilities

  • Contribute to concept development and preliminary design of flexible pipe systems during tendering and FEED phases.
  • Design and analyze subsea flexible pipe systems for offshore applications.
  • Perform structural and hydrodynamic analyses to evaluate system behavior under installation and operational conditions.
  • Assess loading conditions including bending, tension, compression, fatigue, and environmental effects.
  • Support flexible riser configuration design (e.g., free‑hanging, lazy wave) and associated components such as buoyancy modules and bend stiffeners.
  • Contribute to flexible pipe cross‑section design, including material selection, structural capacity, and failure mode evaluation.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, manufacturing, sales, and project management.
  • Participate in technical discussions with clients, installation contractors, and independent verification agencies.
  • Prepare technical documentation, reports, and engineering deliverables.
  • Ensure compliance with industry standards such as API Spec 17J and API RP 17B.

About You

At NOV, we are committed to supporting your professional development from day one. We are looking for engineers who are motivated to solve complex challenges and contribute to the evolution of advanced offshore technologies.

To succeed in this role, you typically have:

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering, Naval Architecture, Civil Engineering, Materials Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Experience in offshore engineering, structural analysis, or subsea systems (experience level may vary).
  • Familiarity with tools such as Orcaflex, finite element analysis software, or similar simulation tools.
  • Experience with Python for engineering analysis, data processing, or automation is considered an advantage.
  • Solid understanding of structural mechanics, hydrodynamics, fatigue, and nonlinear behavior.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and international teams.
  • Good communication skills and ability to present technical information clearly.
  • Professional proficiency in English.

Why Join NOV SPS?

Flexible pipes are among the most complex engineered products in the offshore industry. Every system we deliver is custom designed to meet the specific operational requirements and environmental conditions of each offshore field — from Brazil to Australia, West Africa, and the North Sea.

Working at NOV SPS offers a unique opportunity to be involved in technically challenging projects that are critical to the global energy supply.

At NOV, you will find:

  • A collaborative and international work environment
  • Opportunities to work on cutting‑edge offshore engineering solutions
  • Competitive compensation and benefits
  • Opportunities for professional growth within a global organization
  • Exposure to both engineering design and manufacturing environments

Occasional travel may be required to support project activities or visit NOV sites and customers. You will also have opportunities to visit our Açu manufacturing facility, where you can see flexible pipe systems being produced and prepared for offshore installation.

About Canals

Canals is a fully remote, profitable startup transforming the industrial supply chain ($10T industry) with AI. Our platform seamlessly integrates with the systems distributors already use, automating tedious tasks and reducing failure points in moving physical goods across the globe.

We’re an 80‑person team (~50 in engineering), located across North and South America.

The Role

We’re hiring a Technical Support Agent to help distributors get fast, effective support as they scale on Canals. Our customers rely on our platform for mission‑critical workflows — and maintaining a 1‑minute average response time is part of what sets our team apart.

You’ll troubleshoot technical issues, guide users through our tools, and collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to ensure a seamless customer experience. You’ll also gain exposure to the systems that power our platform — working with tools like Zendesk, Postman, FullStory, and SQL to diagnose and resolve issues.

If you’re a sharp communicator with strong technical instincts and love solving problems quickly and clearly, this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

  • Respond to customer inquiries via live chat and email, maintaining our 1‑minute average first response time.
  • Troubleshoot product and integration issues, escalating when needed to Support Engineers or Product.
  • Use Postman to test API endpoints and SQL to run basic queries for debugging or validation.
  • Investigate customer behavior and issues using FullStory session data.
  • Collaborate closely with CSMs and the Solutions team to ensure smooth onboarding and post‑launch support.
  • Document resolutions and update internal Zendesk macros and knowledge base articles.
  • Identify recurring issues and propose process or product improvements.

What You'll Bring

  • Typically, 1–3 years of experience in technical support for a SaaS product.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — you explain technical issues clearly and concisely.
  • Ability to translate complex topics for non‑technical users.
  • Highly organized, proactive, and comfortable in a fast‑moving startup environment.
  • A genuine sense of urgency — you take pride in speed and quality.

Bonus Points

  • You’ve used tools like Postman, Zendesk, or FullStory to diagnose and resolve issues.
  • You’ve worked in a startup or early‑stage environment and helped shape support processes or playbooks.
  • You have experience supporting non‑technical customers in industrial, logistics, or distribution contexts.
  • You’ve built or refined internal support workflows, macros, or dashboards.

Why Join Canals

  • Real‑world impact: your work improves global supply chains, saving customers time and reducing waste.
  • Strong engineering culture: we invest in quality and documentation to keep moving fast sustainably.
  • Culture of ownership: moving fast while putting quality first.
  • Remote‑first, flexible work environment across North and South America.
  • Stellar product‑market fit with tons of customer love.
  • All‑star team with diverse backgrounds to collaborate with and learn from.

Job Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Position

The FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Human Rights Manager working alongside the FIFA Zurich Human Rights and Anti-Discrimination team and reporting to the Head of Sustainability is responsible for supporting the successful development and implementation of the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ with a particular focus on human rights-related topics. This position plays an integral part in ensuring a successful Tournament through the oversight and implementation of the tournament’s human rights strategy, including the human rights grievance mechanism. As the Tournament draws closer, this role will evolve from planning into operations resulting in an assignment to a competition or non-competition location for the Tournament period.

Key Responsibilities

  • Embed respect for human rights across the tournament organisation and ensure a robust human rights due diligence process in accordance with the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
  • Develop and implement initiatives in particular in the fields of labour rights and anti-discrimination with a view to ensuring respect for labour rights in supply chains for the event as well as an inclusive tournament experience for everyone.
  • Manage the follow up on grievances associated with the tournament received through FIFA’s human rights grievance mechanisms.
  • Working with multiple other functional areas to embed respect for human rights across their policies, procedures and activities.
  • Coordinating a meaningful engagement process with human rights stakeholders in Brazil.
  • Supporting communications efforts on human rights-related topics.
  • Support the maintenance of an effective sustainability management system for the tournament in line with the requirements of ISO 20121, including the development and implementation of action plans and operational processes, capacity building, stakeholder engagement and communication, monitoring and evaluation of performance, and reporting and knowledge transfer.
  • Work closely with the FIFA Human Rights & Anti-Discrimination Department and the FIFA Sustainability & Environment Department based in Zurich and relevant teams within the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ Entity to deliver jointly managed projects and activities.
  • Assist the planning and coordination of meetings, workshops and site visits.

Your Profile

  • A deep passion for human rights, driven to leveraging the unique value of mega-sporting events to contribute to sustainable development goals and the promotion of responsible business practices.
  • Deep familiarity with international human rights standards and in particular the UN Guiding Principles on Business and Human Rights.
  • 5 years of work experience implementing human rights-related programmes.
  • Experience of working in complex, fixed timeline, multi-stakeholder environments.
  • Proven track record of generating productive stakeholder relationships that successfully deliver sustainability/social responsibility outcomes.
  • Proficiency in written and verbal English communication.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Project) and conducting internet-based research.

Candidate Advantages

  • University degree in social sciences, human rights, political science and/or international relations.
  • In-depth knowledge of social responsibility issues, particularly in the context of mega-sporting events.
  • Familiarity with human rights-related legal requirements in Brazil of relevance to the competition.
  • Familiarity with Corporate Social Responsibility ISO 26000 and / or AA1000 Stakeholder Engagement Standards.
  • Developing and delivering capacity-building programmes and training material for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Sustainability performance management, reporting and communications.
  • Working in sports and/or events; and International work experience.

Unique Knowledge and Skills

  • Quick learner with ability to grasp complex structures, projects and relationships in a short timeframe.
  • Self‑motivated, extremely well organised, proactive and accurate.
  • Strong communication skills (both verbal and written).
  • Strong relationship building and conflict resolution skills.
  • Capacity for interacting with people of diverse cultures and backgrounds.
  • Knowledge of worldwide socio‑political and sustainability issues.

Certifications & Requirements

  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Bilingual – Portuguese and English.
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro until the beginning of the Tournament and to assigned Host City for the Tournament operational period.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a Âmbar, a empresa de geração e comercialização de energia do grupo J&F, o maior grupo privado do Brasil. Nosso amplo portfólio de ativos contribui para a expansão e diversificação da matriz energética do Brasil.

Temos 50 unidades de geração de energia, essenciais para a segurança no abastecimento de eletricidade. Nossas usinas fortalecem a transição energética sustentável para o país e para os nossos clientes. Somos o quarto maior gerador de energia a gás natural do Brasil em capacidade instalada. Possuímos ainda unidades hidrelétricas, solares, a biomassa, a carvão mineral e a biogás.

Respaldados pela solidez do grupo J&F, atuamos na comercialização de energia no Mercado Livre e em projetos de Geração Distribuída para clientes em todo o Brasil. Atuamos na gestão completa das contas, criando soluções personalizadas para consumidores e empresas de todos os portes.

Presente em mais de 190 países e com 70 anos de história, o grupo J&F tem um portfólio amplo de empresas. Entre elas estão a JBS, líder global em alimentos à base de proteína, além da Eldorado Brasil Celulose, J&F Mineração, Flora Higiene e Cosméticos, Picpay, Banco Original e Canal Rural.

Estamos em busca de um Supervisor de Manutenção que ficará responsável pela supervisão de toda equipe de manutenção mecânica, através do acompanhamento de cada etapa dos processos existentes, indicadores de desempenho dos colaboradores, compra dos devidos equipamentos a fim de disponibilizar e garantir uma operação funcional confiável em todos os equipamentos da usina.

#LI-Onsite

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Assegurar que os processos da manutenção mecânica sejam executados de uma guisa confiável, supervisionando e executando as manutenções programadas e executadas pelos técnicos mecânicos, através do acompanhamento dos processos em questão, com o propósito de estabelecer a excelência do setor em específico;
  • Assegurar que os equipamentos e sobressalentes sejam comprados corretamente, através da especificação técnica, a fim de adquirir devidamente o maquinário que atenderá toda demanda existente;
  • Executar o plano da manutenção mecânica preventiva, corretiva e preditiva em todos os equipamentos da usina, conforme as ordens de serviços de manutenção originadas pelo programa anual e pela solicitação das ocorrências diárias de manutenção, a fim de atingir as metas de disponibilidade dos equipamentos da planta, qualidade e segurança dos mesmos;
  • Assegurar que os serviços contratados sejam executados conforme especificação, através da coordenação, acompanhamento e supervisão das tarefas efetuadas, com o intuito de atender devidamente que toda a demanda seja concretizada com eficácia e padronização;
  • Contribuir para o alcance dos objetivos, através do cumprimento das metas estabelecidas pela organização, a fim de garantir a excelência de todos os processos que são realizados;
  • Avaliar o desempenho e a necessidade de treinamentos dos colaboradores, através do acompanhamento dos processos e reciclagens, com o intuito de aperfeiçoar o capital intelectual dos mesmos, garantindo resultados para a organização;
  • Obter melhoria contínua dos sistemas, através da implementação de projetos e modificações de rotinas e equipamentos, contribuindo na redução dos custos da manutenção.

Requisitos e qualificações

title: PRODUCT OWNER
description:
Sobre a Vaga


Buscamos um(a) Product Owner com perfil estratégico e relacional para liderar a evolução de produtos e soluções voltadas para o segmento de órgãos institucionais, com foco especial em demandas técnicas do DETRAN. O PO será responsável por traduzir necessidades complexas do cliente em requisitos claros, gerenciar o backlog de produto e garantir a entrega de valor contínuo.


A posição combina análise técnica profunda, relacionamento estratégico com stakeholders (DETRAN, despachantes, entidades e parceiros público-privado) e gestão ágil de produto, com atuação tanto remota quanto em campo para melhor compreensão das demandas.


Principais responsabilidades



  • Elicitar, analisar e documentar requisitos técnicos e funcionais, especialmente de demandas complexas do DETRAN e órgãos institucionais.

  • Gerenciar e priorizar o backlog de produto, alinhando com objetivos estratégicos e necessidades do cliente.

  • Atuar como ponte entre áreas técnicas (desenvolvimento, arquitetura) e stakeholders (DETRAN, clientes, parceiros), garantindo alinhamento de expectativas.

  • Conduzir reuniões de refinamento, validação e aceite de requisitos com foco em clareza e viabilidade técnica.

  • Acompanhar e validar entregas, garantindo conformidade com requisitos e padrões de qualidade.

  • Participar ativamente em campo, com visitas a clientes e órgãos para melhor compreensão do contexto operacional e demandas técnicas.

  • Manter relacionamento estratégico com DETRAN e demais stakeholders, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e inovação.

  • Preparar e acompanhar indicadores de produto (ex.: adoção, satisfação, impacto técnico, ROI).

  • Participar de reuniões internas e alinhar ações com áreas envolvidas (desenvolvimento, operações, comercial, suporte).

  • Documentar decisões, trade-offs e aprendizados para manutenção de histórico e conhecimento institucional.


Requisitos



  • Experiência comprovada como Product Owner ou em papel similar (mínimo 2-3 anos).

  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban) e ferramentas de gestão de produto (Jira, Azure DevOps, Miro ou similar).

  • Forte capacidade de análise técnica e compreensão de arquitetura de software, APIs e integrações.

  • Experiência em relacionamento com clientes institucionais, órgãos públicos ou ambientes regulados é um diferencial.

  • Excelente comunicação, negociação e capacidade de conduzir conversas complexas com diferentes perfis técnicos e não-técnicos.

  • Organização para documentação, rastreamento de requisitos e gestão de prioridades.

  • Conforto com rotina híbrida: remoto + campo (visitas e agendas presenciais).

  • Conhecimento em domínios como DETRAN, trânsito, licitações ou parcerias público-privada é um diferencial.


Desejável



  • Conhecimento estruturado em governança de TI baseado em COBIT (Control Objectives for Information and Related Technologies), incluindo governança e gestão orientada a valor, gestão de riscos, compliance, controles e alinhamento estratégico entre negócio e tecnologia.

  • Domínio prático de frameworks ágeis, especialmente Scrum, incluindo gestão de backlog, sprint planning, review, retrospectiva, escrita de user stories, critérios de aceite e priorização por valor.

  • Conhecimento ou certificação em PMP (Project Management Professional), com entendimento do ecossistema de gestão de projetos, incluindo PMBOK, gestão de escopo, prazo, custo, qualidade, riscos e stakeholders.

  • Capacidade de atuação em ambientes híbridos de gestão (ágil + tradicional), conectando produto, projeto e governança.

  • Conhecimento complementar desejável: ITIL, Lean, Lean Inception, Design Thinking, Product Discovery e Delivery, OKRs e métricas de produto.


Perfil



  • Estratégico e orientado a valor/resultado

  • Relacional e comunicativo, com capacidade de influência

  • Ágil e adaptável a mudanças

  • Organizado(a), disciplinado(a) e orientado(a) a indicadores

  • Proativo(a) e altamente comprometido(a)

  • Pensamento crítico e capacidade de resolver problemas complexos

Summary

Apple Retail is where the best of Apple comes together. We bring our expertise to help people do what they love, delivering an only‑at‑Apple experience. We believe inclusion is a shared responsibility and we work together to foster a culture where everyone belongs and is inspired to do their best work.

Job Overview

As a Senior Manager, you’re responsible for creating a positive environment of customer interactions that effectively drive achievement of performance goals and business priorities. You help drive your store’s vision and purpose, develop other managers, and support the Store Leader with business strategies and critical decision making. While a Senior Manager leads specific parts of the experience, you also help identify, analyze, and solve complex problems in partnership with Store Leader.

Responsibilities

Lead a team (including Managers), empowering each team member to learn, grow, and achieve performance and developmental goals.

Assist with recruiting, training, developing, and retaining a diverse, high‑performing team.

Actively participate in Floor Leadership by interacting with team members and customers throughout the store, modeling what good looks like, and making sure that business priorities are met and exceptional customer service is delivered.

Address customer and team member concerns and escalations, and partner with leadership and key business or People partners when appropriate.

Drive business priorities and achieve store performance goals by establishing, planning, and executing the operational strategy of assigned functional areas and the entire store.

Maintain and uphold company policies and procedures, and protect all company assets, including confidential business, customer, team member, and financial information.

Perform other tasks as needed.

Contribute to an inclusive environment by respecting each other’s differences and having the curiosity to learn.

Demonstrate Apple’s values of inclusion and diversity in daily activities.

Be a role model for inclusive leadership behaviors and build, develop, and retain diverse teams.

Take action to create a safe, respectful, and inclusive environment for all team members.

Minimum Qualifications

  • You should: Be available to work a schedule based on business needs that may include nights, weekends, and public holidays in the retail store, and reliably attend work as scheduled, in line with local laws and subject to any approved accommodations.
  • You should: Have 3 years of leadership experience in retail, sales, or a related field.
  • You should: Be proficient in English and the local language, both written and spoken.

Preferred Qualifications

  • You can: Exceed goals successfully, and persist in accomplishing objectives despite obstacles and setbacks.
  • You can: Follow through on commitments and establish mechanisms to encourage others to do the same.
  • You can: Instill trust within the team and operate with a high level of integrity.
  • You can: Make timely and sound decisions by asking questions and using analytics, experience, and judgment.
  • You can: Communicate with excellence, and tailor your communication style to different audiences.
  • You can: Develop others through mentorship, coaching, and effective feedback.
  • You can: Provide support and guide others through challenges, and step in to handle difficult conversations, while remaining calm in a fast‑paced and constantly changing retail environment.
  • You can: Manage work through effective organization, planning, and prioritization.

Apple is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. Apple provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities and in accordance with local requirements. Apple is a drug‑free workplace.

description:
Descrição da vaga

Acompanhar e/ou implementar os programas de segurança, proteção e meio ambiente, seguindo ou produzindo os seguintes processos: PGR, CIPA, CAT, DDS etc., fiscalizando e acompanhando o uso dos EPI ́s, controlando a data de expiração dos equipamentos e materiais, elaborando relatórios fotográficos, além de palestras e integrações de novos funcionários.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Distribuir diariamente aos colaboradores os EPI`s que serão usados, recolhendo aqueles danificados e separando-os, anotando na ficha pessoal de cada colaborador o que foi retirado e qual a data do trâmite, para fins de enviar uma notificação ao Auxiliar Administrativo para posterior compra, cumprimento da legislação e preservação da integridade física do colaborador;
  • Fazer levantamento diário do estoque de todo o material de segurança do trabalho (entradas e saídas), anotando em planilha manual a relação dos materiais que faltam, repassando ao Administrativo, para fins de reposição de estoque;
  • Visitar diariamente as áreas operacionais, para fins de inspecionar a segurança nas áreas;
  • Fazer vistoria de veículos mensalmente, verificando pessoalmente os freios, faróis e etc., informando aos Terceirizados caso haja necessidade de algum reparo, lançando em planilha feita no Word os problemas relacionados ao veículo e enviando ao Gerente de Filial os problemas encontrados, para fins de manter os veículos em boas condições e segurança dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer análise de risco baseando-se nas atividades que serão feitas pelas equipes, definindo qual será o EPI usado, qual o processo mais seguro para a realização da atividade, enumerando os possíveis riscos, para fins de preservar a integridade física dos colaboradores;
  • Fazer diariamente a inspeção de segurança, especificando as não conformidades existentes nos locais, fazendo um relatório e encaminhando ao Gerente de Filial ou à empresa responsável, para fins de preservar a integridade física do colaborador e do Meio Ambiente;
  • Responsável por elaborar todo trâmite relacionado à eleição da CIPA e os documentos exigidos pelo Ministério do Trabalho e Emprego, para fins de atender a fiscalização trabalhista;
  • Fazer cumprir as ações da CIPA em acordo com o SMS, identificar necessidades, planejar, executar e avaliar programas de treinamento de segurança industrial e meio ambiente;
  • Controlar mensalmente o SESMT, número de acidentes ocorridos em cada setor, através de notificação do ocorrido, reunindo as CATS, análise de levantamento de acidentes, fazendo um parâmetro e calculando as horas perdidas, total de cada setor, enviando as cópias ao Gerente de Filial e a empresa CSN, para fins de controle do número de acidentes e as horas perdidas;
  • Notificar eventualmente, através de comunicado feito em planilha Excel, uma análise do acidente ocorrido através de simulações ou depoimentos, traçando medidas corretivas, enviando ao Supervisor de área em que ocorreu o acidente, para fins de prevenir acidentes com a mesma proporção;
  • Preencher eventualmente no site do INSS, uma CAT no prazo máximo de quarenta e oito horas após o acidente, informando a lesão ocorrida, o local e a hora, o agente causador, a situação causadora, imprimindo uma cópia e arquivando, fornecendo cópia ao colaborador, e enviando através do site do INSS, para fins de comunicar ao INSS, preservar o colaborador de possíveis dificuldades trabalhistas e a empresa de possíveis processos trabalhistas;
  • Coordenar eventualmente a troca ou efetiva recarga de extintores, inspecionando um a um, mantendo contato direto com a empresa responsável pela manutenção dos extintores para fins da Triunfo estar preparada caso ocorra algum incêndio;

Responsabilidades

  • Garantir a adequada implementação dos Programas de Compliance, incluindo os temas de integridade e direitos humanos, por meio da condução de avaliações de riscos de processos, acompanhamento de controles e monitoramento de indicadores de eficácia, assegurando aderência à Lei Anticorrupção (Lei nº 12.846/13 e Decreto nº 11.129/22), à legislação de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro (Lei nº 9.613/98), às obrigações regulatórias aplicáveis, às boas práticas de governança corporativa, às diretrizes de direitos humanos e às principais referências internacionais, como FCPA (EUA) e UK Bribery Act (Reino Unido).

  • Apoiar a elaboração, revisão e aprimoramento de políticas, normas e procedimentos, assegurando sua aderência às exigências regulatórias e promovendo a melhoria contínua e a eficiência dos processos da Companhia, com fortalecimento do ambiente de controle.
  • Preparar materiais e evidências para auditorias internas, externas e projetos, bem como apoiar o mapeamento, avaliação e testes de controles de compliance em processos críticos, executando walkthroughs e testes de amostragem, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e tempestividade das entregas.
  • Apoiar a análise e resposta a consultas relacionadas aos temas de Compliance (doações e patrocínios, brindes e hospitalidade, conflito de interesses, contratações…), sob a ótica de riscos de integridade, reputacionais e regulatórios, elaborando pareceres de compliance e orientando as áreas quanto às salvaguardas e aos controles aplicáveis.
  • Acompanhar, analisar e reportar indicadores (KPI’s) do Programa de Compliance.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de reports internos de Compliance.
  • Apoiar as áreas na elaboração de reportes externos, como o Formulário de Referência (CVM) e o Relatório de Sustentabilidade.
  • Apoiar a execução do programa de gestão de riscos de compliance, incluindo a atualização do Mapa de Riscos e Controles, com base em frameworks de gestão de riscos.

  • Apoiar e conduzir treinamentos de compliance para áreas da Companhia.

Qualificações

  • Formação acadêmica Graduação em Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas; desejável pós-graduação em Compliance, Governança ou Gestão de Riscos.
  • Certificações Desejáveis CCEP, CPC-A; auditor/implementer ISO 37001/37301 e certificações em gestão de riscos (como ISO 31000 ou certificações correlatas).
  • Conhecimentos específicos Sólidos em Due diligence de Integridade, em Lei nº 12.846/2013 e Decreto nº 11.129/2022, com familiaridade com legislações internacionais anticorrupção e antissuborno, como FCPA (EUA) e UK Bribery Act (Reino Unido), bem como com regimes de sanções internacionais (ex.: OFAC, União Europeia) e diretrizes e referências nacionais e internacionais aplicáveis, incluindo o Programa de Integridade da CGU e as diretrizes da OCDE; experiência em controles internos, matriz de riscos e indicadores (KRIs e KPIs), incluindo vivência em avaliações de maturidade de programas de integridade (ex.: Pró-Ética e Ethos).
  • Conhecimento em proteção de dados e privacidade (LGPD), e desejável familiaridade com a regulação aplicável ao setor de óleo e gás (ANP).
  • Ferramentas e sistemas Conhecimento em ferramentas de produtividade, análise de dados e automação, incluindo uso de inteligência artificial aplicada ao trabalho, automação de tarefas (ex.: Power Automate) e elaboração de dashboards (ex.: Power BI), bem como familiaridade com Python (desejável) e com ferramentas de due diligence de integridade.

Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visam diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Buscamos um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Produção para atuar no time de Subsuperfície. Será responsável por liderar o desenvolvimento e a aplicação de soluções avançadas para otimização da produção dos campos da PRIO, assegurando a máxima eficiência dos sistemas de elevação artificial.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar estudos avançados sobre métodos de elevação artificial, propondo soluções inovadoras e revisando criticamente os designs dos fornecedores, com foco em eficiência, confiabilidade e aderência aos limites operacionais dos equipamentos.
  • Desenvolver modelos de monitoramento preditivo dos sistemas de elevação artificial e escoamento, utilizando ferramentas analíticas e inteligência de dados para antecipar falhas, promover melhorias contínuas e garantir a excelência operacional.
  • Conduzir e validar testes FAT e SIT de equipamentos complexos, definindo critérios técnicos e elaborando relatórios robustos que suportem decisões estratégicas de operação, confiabilidade e manutenção.
  • Orquestrar análises de falhas críticas e troubleshooting em sistemas de elevação artificial e escoamento, liderando a interface técnica com fornecedores e propondo soluções estruturadas que impactem positivamente a performance dos ativos.
  • Desenhar e revisar procedimentos operacionais de poços com base em dados integrados de produção, operação e histórico de falhas, garantindo máxima eficiência, segurança e conformidade regulatória.
  • Avaliar com profundidade os testes de produção periódicos, correlacionando dados operacionais com estratégias de reservatório, propondo ajustes técnicos que otimizem o desempenho dos poços e a recuperação dos ativos.
  • Gerenciar contratos estratégicos de fornecedores, conduzindo revisões técnicas e comerciais das medições mensais, custos de manutenção e intervenções, assegurando conformidade com cláusulas contratuais e metas operacionais.
  • Produzir relatórios técnicos, análises de risco e indicadores de performance com base em dados históricos dos poços, consolidando conhecimento para decisões estratégicas de produção e redução de custos.
  • Integrar informações operacionais às previsões de produção dos campos e potenciais aquisições, colaborando com áreas técnicas e de negócio para aumentar a assertividade das projeções e decisões de investimento.
  • Planejar e revisar o capítulo do Programa de Intervenção de poço, definindo estratégias para instalação ou retirada de sistemas de elevação artificial com foco em segurança, eficiência e compliance técnico.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior completa em Engenharia (preferencialmente Engenharia de Petróleo, Mecânica ou Química), com pós-graduação ou especialização em Engenharia de Produção, Sistemas de Elevação Artificial ou áreas correlatas.
  • Domínio técnico de métodos avançados de elevação artificial, modelagem de reservatórios, simulações de produção e ferramentas de análise preditiva (como PipeSim, Prosper, OLGA, Petrel).
  • Conhecimento aprofundado em normas técnicas nacionais e internacionais (ANP, API, ISO), gestão de contratos complexos e indicadores de performance.
  • Inglês avançado.

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that, for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Department

Communications

Location

Brazil (Rio de Janeiro)

Position

The Junior Graphic Designer at FWWC27 LTDA, which is FIFA’s Brazilian subsidiary responsible for the delivery of FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 Brazil, will play a pivotal role in shaping the expression of the FIFA brand across global platforms and live event environments. You will support the creative development of brand assets, ensuring consistent, world‑class creative output aligned with FIFA’s strategic brand objectives. This role is critical to the success of the first ever FIFA Women’s World Cup to be held in South America, with a vision to unite the world through an unprecedented experience that celebrates and elevates women’s football.

Purpose of the Role: This role combines world‑class graphic design excellence, strong project‑management skills, and a deep understanding of global audiences, especially in sports and entertainment. It reports to the Global Head of Brand, Marketing & Promotions and acts as an extension to the Brand team based in Zurich with dual reporting lines.

Key Responsibilities

Graphic Design & Brand Expression

  • Supports the creative process from concept to execution across channels, ensuring high‑quality outcomes aligned with FIFA’s brand vision.
  • Designs and produces creative content across brand graphics, event branding, venue dressing, broadcast environments, digital experiences, motion design, and video content.
  • Develops key visuals, brand toolkits, motion graphics packages, environmental branding concepts, and digital‑first creative assets.
  • Ensures strict adherence to FIFA’s visual identity standards while pushing creative boundaries within those frameworks.

Creative Expertise

  • Graphic design experience in brand creation and brand assets and collaterals.
  • Deep visual sensibility and an understanding of brand identity systems across static, dynamic, and environmental media.
  • High‑level conceptual thinker with a passion for visual storytelling, motion language, and digital engagement.
  • Hands‑on graphic skills, capable of leading from the front while mentoring junior creatives.

Executional Skills

  • Skilled at balancing creative ambition with operational precision and production feasibility.
  • Experienced in managing multiple concurrent projects under tight timelines with consistent attention to detail and creative quality.
  • Familiar with rights management, usage permissions, and protection of brand and design IP.

Your Profile

Qualifications & Experience

  • Degree or diploma in Graphic Design, Visual Communication, or a related creative discipline.
  • Proven hands‑on expertise in Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, Premiere Pro).
  • Experience working with large‑scale brand projects and live events, from concepting event look & feel to developing venue branding systems.
  • Proficient in Word, PowerPoint, Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign, After Effects, and Premiere Pro.
  • Minimum 3–5 years of experience in graphic design roles within agency, entertainment, FMCG, or sports‑related industries.

Requirements

  • Fluent in Portuguese and English.
  • Right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro.

title: Head of Legal
description:
About InPlanet

InPlanet is a mission-driven, remote-first ClimateTech startup headquartered between Germany and Brazil with hubs in Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, New York and London. We’re scaling Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) in tropical agriculture as a powerful method to remove carbon, regenerate soils, and transform the way food is grown in the tropics. Our vision is simple but bold:to sequester gigatons of CO2while regenerating tropical soils in order to create a livable planet with nutritious food and healthy ecosystems for future generations. We’re doing this in partnership with farmers, scientists, and industry leaders - and we’re growing fast. Our company culture blends people-first care andperformance excellence . The Rocket represents our ambition and drive; the Heart symbolizes our focus on empathy, integrity, and collective impact. We’re proud of our globally diverse team and inclusive culture. Our teams span across continents, but our boots are firmly on the ground in Brazil - where the real climate impact happens. You can check out independent reviews by other candidates on Glassdoor to check how people find interviewing with us. Check out our Culture page here

About the Role

We are looking for a Head of Legal to strengthen and lead the legal function at InPlanet, acting as a strategic partner to the business in a highly complex, science-, operations- and contract-based environment. This role sits at the intersection of climate, mining, agriculture, and carbon markets , requiring someone who can connect legal, operational, and commercial perspectives across Brazil and international markets. This role is well suited to someone who has experience leading legal functions within a fast-growing, ambitious startup, or who has worked closely with startup ventures as a trusted legal advisor. We are also open to candidates with strong standalone experience, as well as those coming from agency, law firm or financial markets environments. A structured business mindset and a holistic approach to the needs of a growing startup are essential, and these qualities will be assessed throughout the interview process.

  • Enable the company to scale effectively through strong legal foundations
  • Act as the legal backbone for strategic decisions , from operations to international expansion
  • Structure and support complex, cross-border deals and partnerships
  • Ensure robust governance, compliance, and risk management across all activities
  • Bridge legal across Science, Operations, Supply, Business Development and People
  • Strengthen investor confidence through clear and reliable legal frameworks
  • Manage external network of trusted legal advisors

Core working relationships

  • Directly reporting to the CFO.
  • Internal: Science & Operations Team, HR, Business Development, Leadership & Investors
  • External: Legal boutiques (contracts & commercial), Tax advisors, Governance specialists, Regulatory bodies

Context of the role:

  • You will join a lean and evolving legal function , with high ownership from day one
  • Legal demand is rapidly growing alongside company scale
  • Strong need to connect legal across international teams (Science, Carbon, BD)
  • The role has potential to evolve into VP Legal , depending on scope and impact

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the central legal hub across all company functions, both locally (Brazil) and internationally
  • Lead due diligence processes (legal and regulatory)
  • Structure, negotiate, and manage complex contracts , including:
    • Farmers, Mining partners, NDAs, Joint ventures, International commercial agreements, Corporate documentation (e.g. Investment agreements)
  • Own cross-border legal strategy and execution
  • Strengthen and improve corporate governance and entity structures (Brazil & international)
  • Work closely with tax advisors
  • Ensure compliance across multiple regulatory domains , including environmental, mining, agribusiness, and carbon markets
  • Support the People Team with labour and service provision requirement
  • Support investor relations from a legal standpoint
  • Build scalable legal processes, templates, and infrastructure

You can be a Rock-Star if you have

Core Skills & Experience

  • Law degree with active OAB registration (Brazil)
  • 8–15+ years of experience , ideally with strong exposure to environmental, operations or infrastructure-related sectors
  • Proven experience in:
    • Commercial and business law, ideally from a startup angle
    • Due diligence (legal & regulatory)
    • Complex contract structuring and negotiation
    • International contracts and cross-border operations
  • Strong background in business-oriented legal roles (e.g., General Counsel, senior associate in relevant practice areas)
  • Solid experience with:
    • Corporate law and governance
    • Investor relations and strategic partnerships
  • Fluency in English , with experience working in international environments

Key Qualities

  • Business-oriented mindset : understands legal as a driver of growth
  • Highly relational : strong stakeholder management across cultures and functions
  • Strategic thinker : connects science, operations, and business into legal frameworks
  • Pragmatic and solution-driven : balances risk with execution speed
  • High ownership : comfortable operating as a senior, autonomous leader in a lean structure
  • Strong institutional presence : capable of representing the company externally
  • Structured and integrative : able to navigate and connect multiple regulatory domains
  • Neutral and sound judgment , especially in complex or sensitive matters

Bonus Points (but not essential)

  • Experience in environmental, mining, agribusiness, or carbon markets
  • Background in startups, scale-ups, or boutique law firms
  • Exposure to governance and international structures
  • Postgraduate degree (LL.M., ESG, Business Law, etc.)
  • Business and legal experience in Germany
  • Speaks German
  • Based in a city with relatively easy access to Sao Paulo/SP

Living Our Values

At InPlanet, we have a big vision of solving climate change, and we are looking for individuals who are genuinely passionate about making a positive difference in the world of Carbon Removal Solutions. Trust guides our actions, drive fuels our efforts, and impact is our goal.

  • Trust : You believe in being kind and transparent in the workplace, fostering an environment where trust thrives and collaboration flourishes
  • Drive : You possess an innate drive to take action with a hands-on, can-do attitude, propelled by urgency
  • Impact : You dream big and are committed to making a meaningful difference in the world, aligning with our overarching mission to address climate change

Benefits

  • Compensation expectations and our compensation philosophy are openly discussed in the first interview with the goal of managing expectations fairly.
  • Equity to feel like an owner
  • Home Office Budget
  • Fully Remote: Join us from anywhere within the CET (- 4/5-hour time zones).
  • Personal development budget
  • Language Programme Monthly Allowance
  • 40+ days annual leave
  • The opportunity to be autonomous, make a huge difference and belong to a vision.
  • Occasional off-sites in Brazil yay!
  • Laptop to fuel your productivity

InPlanet Compensation Philosophy

At InPlanet, our philosophy revolves around ensuring fair and unbiased compensation and equitable equity pay, coupled with competitive benefits, across all regions where we operate. The reason behind our salary range being wide or undefined at the first stages of the interview is because of our international presence and globally distributed workforce, we utilize geo ranges to account for varying pay differentials, forming a crucial part of our global compensation strategy to remain competitive across diverse markets as we expand our reach. These ranges are determined by role, level, and location, recognizing the nuanced demands of each market. The actual base pay for the selected candidate is influenced by factors such as location, skills, experience, training, business requirements, and market dynamics, with the range subject to potential adjustments in alignment with our commitment to fairness and transparency.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Being an equal opportunities work provider is very important to us, and we are committed to ensuring that no applicant receives less favourable treatment on the grounds of gender, age, disability, religion, belief, sexual orientation, marital status, or race, or is disadvantaged by conditions which cannot be shown to be justifiable. We design our processes to be fair and equitable, and we believe in continuous learning.

A Eneva é a maior operadora privada de gás natural do Brasil, atuando de forma integrada da produção à geração de energia e avançando de maneira consistente na comercialização de gás natural. Em 2026, a companhia vive um ciclo de expansão impulsionado por novos projetos estruturantes e pelos leilões do LRCAP, ampliando sua relevância estratégica no setor energético nacional. Esse movimento exige uma atuação cada vez mais integrada entre Negócio, Tecnologia e áreas Institucionais, com foco em eficiência, governança, compliance e geração de valor sustentável.

Sobre a posição

Buscamos um(a) IT Business Partner para atuar como elo estratégico entre Tecnologia e Negócios, com foco principal na área de Comercialização de Gás e Energia, e atuação transversal junto às áreas Institucionais (Jurídico, ESG e Comunicação Interna e Externa).

Essa posição é chave para evolução e captura de valor da plataforma Salesforce e demais sistemas para suportar:

  • O ciclo comercial do gás (originação, negociação e relacionamento);
  • A gestão de contratos complexos e de longo prazo;
  • A integração entre áreas de negócio, institucional e tecnologia.

Principais responsabilidades

  • Liderar a evolução da plataforma Salesforce, garantindo aderência aos processos comerciais;
  • Apoiar a área Comercial na estruturação de processos digitais para negociação, relacionamento com clientes, contratos e gestão do funil comercial de gás e energia;
  • Apoiar as áreas Jurídica, ESG e Comunicação na identificação de oportunidades de uso de tecnologia para governança, compliance, rastreabilidade e reporte;
  • Conduzir processos de discovery, ideação e definição de soluções, promovendo workshops colaborativos e alinhamento entre stakeholders;
  • Avaliar demandas, conduzir estudos de viabilidade e business cases, apoiando a tomada de decisão executiva;
  • Apoiar provas de conceito (PoCs) e a captura de benefícios das iniciativas implementadas;
  • Produzir relatórios e apresentações executivas para acompanhamento do portfólio, evolução das iniciativas e governança de TI;
  • Atuar de forma ativa na melhoria contínua dos processos, sistemas e modelos de atuação entre TI e Negócio.

Requisitos e qualificações

Formação

This role focuses on performing detailed plan and design reviews, resolving issues related to conflicting design requirements, ensuring client requirements and applicable standards are met. Projects could include the approval of new building, conversion, and existing vessels and yachts.

Key Accountabilities

  • Review and approve hull structural drawings of ships, offshore units, and marine equipment, in compliance with Class Rules and Statutory Regulations, for new buildings, ships in service, and ship’s conversions.
  • Assist clients during the design and construction phase, providing guidance and support related to structural design.

Education

Bachelor’s Degree in Naval Engineering

Qualifications

Experience

  • Experience in hull design, shipbuilding, or marine engineering, with a focus on plan approval in a Class Society or shipbuilding environment.
  • Experience in the review and approval of hull structural designs, stability calculations, and material selection, ensuring compliance with applicable rules and regulations.
  • Practical experience working with international maritime standards (SOLAS, MARPOL, etc.) and Class Society regulations.
  • In-depth experience in the hull plan approval process, including structural integrity verification, load distribution, and strength calculations.

Technical Skills

  • Advanced understanding of ship hull design principles, structural components, and materials used in hull construction.

title: Vendedor  - Rede de Franquias
description:
Um vendedor de loja desempenha um papel crucial em garantir que os clientes tenham uma experiência de compra satisfatória e eficiente.

As principais responsabilidades de um vendedor incluem:

  • Atendimento ao Cliente: Receber e saudar os clientes, oferecer assistência na escolha de produtos, responder a perguntas e fornecer informações detalhadas sobre itens e promoções.
  • Apresentação e Demonstração de Produtos: Mostrar produtos aos clientes, explicar suas características e benefícios, e fazer recomendações com base nas necessidades e preferências dos clientes.
  • Processamento de Vendas: Ajudar no processo de checkout, que pode incluir operar a caixa registradora ou sistema de ponto de venda (PDV), embalar produtos e realizar transações de pagamento.
  • Gestão de Estoque: Monitorar níveis de estoque, reabastecer prateleiras e expositores, e garantir que os produtos estejam sempre disponíveis e bem apresentados.
  • Organização da Loja: Manter a loja limpa e organizada, rearranjar produtos e garantir que a área de vendas esteja sempre atraente e acessível para os clientes.
  • Promoções e Ofertas: Informar os clientes sobre promoções e ofertas especiais, e incentivá-los a aproveitar essas oportunidades.
  • Resolução de Problemas: Lidar com reclamações e problemas dos clientes de maneira eficiente e profissional, buscando soluções que atendam às necessidades dos clientes e mantenham a boa reputação da loja.
  • Atingir Metas de Vendas: Trabalhar para atingir ou superar as metas de vendas estabelecidas pela loja, usando técnicas de vendas e estratégias para maximizar as oportunidades.
  • Atualização e Treinamento: Manter-se atualizado sobre os produtos, tendências de mercado e políticas da loja, participando de treinamentos e reuniões conforme necessário.
  • Feedback e Melhoria Contínua: Fornecer feedback à gerência sobre as necessidades dos clientes e quaisquer problemas que possam impactar a experiência de compra, contribuindo para melhorias contínuas na operação da loja.

Essas responsabilidades ajudam a criar uma experiência de compra positiva, aumentar as vendas e fortalecer o relacionamento com os clientes, o que é essencial para o sucesso de nossas lojas.

Descrição da vaga

#VemSerMAG

Se você quer trabalhar com propósito, desenvolver sua carreira, mas sem deixar de lado sua saúde e bem-estar, a MAG é o seu lugar! Temos em nosso DNA a inovação e o cuidado com as pessoas. Desde 2016 estamos na lista das melhores empresas para se trabalhar, segundo a Great Place to Work.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL!

Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de todos os nossos colaboradores pertencentes a, pelo menos, um grupo minorizado. Contamos também com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Nosso propósito e valores

Estamos em busca de pessoas que tenham valores alinhados aos nossos: Atitude de dono, História de transformação, Relações duradouras e Ser presente.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros . Nos últimos três anos, realizamos o pagamento de mais de R$ 1 bilhão em benefícios a milhares de famílias. Dados como esse que nos levam a ser referência no mercado de Vida e Previdência, com quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta no Brasil.

Somos parte do Grupo Aegon, um dos maiores grupos de Seguro de Vida e Previdência do mundo. No Brasil, nossa força também impressiona: temos mais de 5,8 milhões de vidas seguradas e crescemos, em média, 16% ao ano na última década.

Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

The Technical Implementation Specialist is responsible for bridging the gap between our core LPPA extraction tool engine and our clients’ downstream internal systems. You are essentially the “Last Mile” problem solver. While our platform excels at turning unstructured investment documents into structured data, our clients cannot realize the full value of that data if it doesn't “talk” to their existing downstream systems (like eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs).

You will be responsible for solving the “Last Mile” delivery problem—ensuring that the data we extract is not just accurate, but immediately actionable within the client’s unique technical ecosystem. This involves navigating complex data mapping, managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, and acting as the go‑to for delivering bespoke integration solutions in the template the client needs under tight deadlines.

The team's core mission is to solve the “Last Mile” problem in data delivery and utilization, specifically focusing on custom integration. Our platform excels at transforming unstructured investment documents into structured data. However, this data only achieves its full value when it seamlessly integrates with a client's existing downstream systems (such as eFront, Investran, or internal ERPs). The Custom Integration Lead acts as the crucial bridge between our core data extraction engine and these client‑specific systems. This role is responsible for ensuring the extracted data is immediately actionable within the client’s unique technical environment.

This Involves

  • Act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients requiring custom delivery solutions.
  • Analyze client downstream system requirements to draft comprehensive Functional & Technical Specification files.
  • Navigating complex data mapping requirements.
  • Managing secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures.
  • Leading a technical team to deliver bespoke integration solutions in the client‑required format and under tight deadlines.
  • Facilitate daily stand‑ups to track progress, remove blockers, and ensure alignment with the delivery roadmap.
  • Perform Internal QA on custom templates (Excel, CSV, JSON) to ensure 100% accuracy against the signed‑off specifications.
  • Act as the first line of defense for production issues: perform initial triage and investigation of reported bugs.

The Team You’ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Custom Integrations Team, a specialized engineering and delivery pod within the broader R&D and Implementation/delivery teams. Our team is the critical link between our core LPPA engine and the production environments of the world’s leading Limited Partners (LPs). We are a high‑impact, agile unit consisting of a Lead, a Tech Lead, and Developers, dedicated to architecting bespoke data transformation and delivery solutions. By ensuring our data integrates seamlessly into diverse downstream systems, we directly enable our clients to achieve real‑time visibility into their private market investments. Our work is the final, essential step in the value chain, turning raw extracted data into a functional, automated asset for our customers.

About You

  • Technical Liaison. You act as the primary technical point of contact for new clients, translating complex downstream system requirements into comprehensive Functional and Technical Specification files.
  • Integration Architect. You are adept at navigating complex data mapping requirements and are familiar with secure connectivity across diverse IT infrastructures, including APIs, SFTP, SharePoint, and Cloud Storage.

  • First‑Line Responder. You act as the first line of defense for production issues, performing the initial triage and root‑cause investigation of reported bugs before prioritizing engineering tickets.
  • 3+ years of experience recommended in technical implementation, integration engineering, or technical project management.

When we say, “the stuff dreams are made of,” we’re not just referring to the world of wizards, dragons and superheroes, or even to the wonders of Planet Earth. Behind WBD’s vast portfolio of iconic content and beloved brands, are the storytellers bringing our characters to life, the creators bringing them to your living rooms and the dreamers creating what’s next…

From brilliant creatives, to technology trailblazers, across the globe, WBD offers career defining opportunities, thoughtfully curated benefits, and the tools to explore and grow into your best selves. Here you are supported, here you are celebrated, here you can thrive.

Your new role

Planejar, coordenar e executar transmissões ao vivo e gravadas (TV linear, streaming e plataformas digitais), garantindo qualidade editorial, operacional e comercial.

Your role accountabilities

  1. Planejamento Editorial e Operacional das Transmissões
    • Planejar o detalhamento das transmissões (pré-jogo, jogo, intervalo, pós-jogo, programas especiais e conteúdos complementares).
    • Montar, atualizar e distribuir o espelho de transmissão (running order), definindo blocos, entradas de VT, participações, quadros, ações de marca, chamadas e integrações com digital.
    • Articular com técnica, Comercial, Marketing, Digital e parceiros externos para alinhar necessidades, horários, janelas e fluxos.
  2. Coordenação de Equipe e Fluxo “On Air”
    • Atuar como ponto focal entre direção de TV, operação técnica, master, estúdio, talentos (apresentadores, comentaristas, repórteres) e equipe de digital/social.
    • Distribuir tarefas para o time envolvido na transmissão, garantindo que todos tenham briefing claro de pauta, formato e entregas comerciais.
    • Durante o ao vivo, ajustar o espelho em tempo real, de acordo com o andamento do jogo/evento, imprevistos técnicos, demandas editoriais ou comerciais.
    • Controlar o tempo de blocos, entradas e saídas de VT, uso de GC, estatísticas, chamadas e quadros especiais.
  3. Produção de Conteúdo e Preparação de Materiais
    • Pesquisar, apurar e organizar informações relevantes sobre os eventos (ficha técnica, escalações, estatísticas, curiosidades, histórico, bastidores).
    • Elaborar e/ou ajustar roteiros, textos, notas, apoiando talentos e direção com conteúdo contextualizado e atualizado.
    • Solicitar e acompanhar a produção de artes, GC, vinhetas, trilhas, bumpers, layouts de estatísticas e demais elementos gráficos necessários.
    • Coordenar com o time de digital os conteúdos que serão aproveitados em redes sociais, cortes, chamadas e interações ao vivo.
    • Participar ativamente de reuniões com outras áreas envolvidas nos eventos.
  4. Gestão de Entregas Comerciais e Branded Content
    • Garantir que todas as entregas comerciais e ativações de marca estejam previstas no espelho (citadas, GC, vinhetas, quadros patrocinados, “golden breaks”, chamadas, integrações com digital etc.).
    • Coordenar a execução dessas entregas no ar, verificando texto, tempo de tela, posição no bloco, identidade visual e adequação à linha editorial.
    • Registrar as entregas realizadas, apoiando o time Comercial na prestação de contas e no pós-venda.
    • Sugerir formatos de ativações que equilibrem qualidade editorial, experiência da audiência e resultado comercial.
  5. Qualidade Editorial, Conformidade e Padrões de Marca
    • Assegurar que a linguagem, o tom e o formato das transmissões estejam alinhados à estratégia da marca e às características de cada plataforma (TV, streaming, YouTube, redes sociais).
    • Garantir o cumprimento de diretrizes de direitos de transmissão, uso de imagem, política das ligas/federações e normas internas da empresa.
    • Apoiar a direção na priorização de pautas, escolha de quadros e ajustes da narrativa ao longo da transmissão.
  6. Pós-Transmissão e Melhoria Contínua
    • Participar e/ou conduzir o debrief das transmissões, identificando acertos, falhas e oportunidades de melhoria.
    • Consolidar relatórios qualitativos e, quando aplicável, quantitativos (execução de entregas, problemas técnicos, feedback de audiência e repercussão digital).
    • Manter histórico de espelhos, roteiros, formatos e boas práticas, servindo como base para evolução dos produtos.

Qualification & Experiencie

  • Experiência em produção e coordenação de transmissões ao vivo, preferencialmente no universo esportivo.
  • Conhecimento de fluxo de TV e streaming: master, ingest, grade, breaks, GC, estúdio, links, retornos, etc.
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de espelho/rundown, planilhas e apresentações (Excel/Sheets, PowerPoint/Slides ou similares).
  • Noções básicas de métricas de audiência e consumo em plataformas digitais.
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de briefings comerciais e orientações de ligas/federações.

Championing Inclusion at WBD

Warner Bros. Discovery embraces the opportunity to build a workforce that reflects a wide array of perspectives, backgrounds and experiences.   • SCM

  • Environmental Specialists
  • Vessel Operations Managers

Qualifications

    • General experience of all shallow and deepwater water installation operations.
