title: Integrity Engineer
description:
Job Function:

Employment Type: Permanent

Yinson is a dynamic, equal opportunity employer with great organisational culture where people are valued and empowered to deliverpowerful solutions.

Sumary:

Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda is seeking a dedicated Integrity Engineer. This important role supports the onshore operations with a key focus on maintaining and assuring the integrity and safe operation of FPSOunits and associated equipment.

As an Integrity Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in safeguarding the company’s interests by ensuring all inspection, testing, and maintenance activities on critical equipment are carried out with high standards of safety, compliance, and efficiency. You will be integral to a team committed to operational excellence and proactive risk management within the offshore oil and gas sector.

Key Responsibilities

  • Organise and oversee the activities related to NR 13 / SPIE compliance in collaboration with equipment inspectors from FPSO units, including maintaining comprehensive and up-to-date documentation such as official books, calibration certificates, inspection reports, and audit records.
  • Manage internal and external inspection schedules, ensuring adherence to regulatory and company standards, while maintaining close coordination with operation managers to integrate inspection activities within shutdown plans effectively.
  • Lead the evaluation and implementation of training programs for Equipment Inspectors, Operators, and Technicians to uphold competency and safety standards across all levels of operations.
  • Maintain and regularly update the equipment master list to reflect current status and compliance details.
  • Define testing, measurement, replacements, repairs, and modification schedules based on written procedures, ensuring the physical condition of critical equipment meets operational safety requirements.
  • Ensure rigorous verification and performance testing of safety valves and other safety-critical equipment, either by performing, witnessing, or overseeing such tests to guarantee reliable operation.
  • Conduct audits of equipment manufacturers as required, supporting thorough supplier qualification and quality assurance.
  • Collaborate effectively with internal stakeholders (Yinson teams) and external parties (clients, contractors) to foster transparent communication and alignment on objectives and compliance requirements.
  • Perform additional duties as assigned by management in support of the company’s goals and regulatory compliance.
  • Commercial Awareness: Understand the wider business context and how operational integrity relates to company performance and risk management.
  • Safeguarding Company Interest: Demonstrate commitment to protecting company assets, reputation, and operational continuity.
  • Cost Control Experience: Apply cost control principles within offshore oil and gas projects to optimise expenditure without compromising safety or quality.
  • Teamwork: Work collaboratively across multi-disciplinary teams and with external partners, fostering a positive and productive working environment.
  • Communication Skills: Communicate effectively at all organisational levels, both verbally and in writing, ensuring clarity and professionalism in all interactions.
  • Analytical and Problem-Solving Abilities: Use strong analytical skills to assess equipment conditions, interpret inspection data, and develop practical solutions.
  • Attention to Detail: Maintain accuracy in documentation, procedures, and reporting to support compliance and operational excellence.
  • Responsibility and Proactivity: Take ownership of tasks, demonstrate initiative, and work in a hands‑on manner to achieve targets and resolve issues promptly.

Qualifications and Experience

  • Engineering degree is mandatory.
  • CREA‑RJ accreditation is required.
  • Post‑Graduation degree in a relevant field will be considered a strong advantage.
  • Experience as an Operations Engineer within the Brazilian oil and gas sector, with experience specifically in integrity engineering preferred.
  • Proven experience working with FPSO projects and offshore operations is highly desirable.
  • Fluent English and Portuguese verbal and written communication skills to effectively liaise with diverse teams and stakeholders.

Why Join Us?

At Yinson Brasil Serviços Ltda, you will become part of a forward‑thinking and inclusive team dedicated to safe and sustainable offshore operations. We value initiative and provide opportunities for professional growth within a dynamic sector. Our collaborative culture encourages knowledge sharing and continuous improvement, enabling you to make a tangible impact in a challenging and rewarding environment.

If you are a focused, detail‑oriented professional with a strong commitment to equipment integrity and operational safety, and you thrive in a team‑oriented setting, this role offers an excellent platform to advance your career in offshore production.

description:
Descrição sumária

Gerenciar e assegurar a operação contínua e estável de sistemas críticos de emissão de apólices e gestão de sinistros, execução de atividades, iniciativas e projetos de infraestrutura, suporte ao usuário, ERP e Dados, visando a transformação, simplificação e otimização do ecossistema computacional da seguradora.

Apoiar o CIO em atividades e planos estratégicos, planos táticos e operacionais, buscando a entrega de soluções tecnológicas de apoio às demandas de negócio.

Identificar oportunidades e novas ferramentas para otimização da execução de projetos de TI e projetos corporativos, com análise de custo/benefício, comparação de eventuais soluções disponíveis no mercado em relação ao desenvolvimento/execução interna, implantar soluções definidas de acordo com as especificações funcionais e auxiliar na elaboração de prazos e orçamentos definidos.

Atribuições do Cargo

  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento da estratégia corporativa para transformação na qualidade e prestação de serviços providos pela área de TI para os usuários internos e externos, no alinhamento das metas e objetivos definidos pela área de TI com as metas corporativas;
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de “roadmap” para execução de projetos do ponto de vista técnico de TI, seguido de elaboração e execução de plano de ação;
  • Assegurar a aderência das atividades de infraestrutura, ERP, dados e suporte às demandas das áreas de negócios da empresa;
  • Definição de métricas de desempenho da equipe e dos serviços prestados;
  • Identificar, viabilizar a implementação e gerenciar soluções de tecnologia internas e/ou externas para aumentar a eficácia e eficiência operacional, qualidade dos serviços e nível de governança da seguradora, de acordo com as necessidades identificadas/reportadas;
  • Gerenciar, em conjunto com o coordenador da área, o desenvolvimento da infraestrutura, da implantação e atualização de sistemas, softwares e de soluções de tecnologia;
  • Atender demandas do CEO, COO e do CIO e demais diretores quando solicitado;
  • Aplicar processos e políticas de governança da empresa e contribuir com melhorias;
  • Planejar, documentar, executar e testar estratégias e procedimentos de contingências, visando a segurança de dados e informações;
  • Auxiliar nas atividades de auditorias e continuidade dos serviços;
  • Manter monitoramento, avaliação de desempenho e qualificação das equipes, visando a manutenção da motivação, a fim de obter os melhores resultados das atividades da área e a busca pelas melhores soluções técnicas;
  • Buscar tendências de mercado e necessidades identificadas na seguradora para evolução tecnológica dos serviços e soluções ofertados ao mercado;
  • Relacionar‑se com fornecedores de produtos e serviços de tecnologias, garantindo atendimento aos interesses e às necessidades da empresa;
  • Realizar gestão, acompanhamento e cumprimento dos contratos firmados pela área de TI;
  • Cumprir o orçamento anual previsto para a área de TI;
  • Gerenciar as interações com os provedores de soluções externas;
  • Participar de reuniões periódicas com a Diretoria de TI;
  • Produzir relatório mensal demonstrando resultados, incidentes e monitoramento das atividades em andamento;
  • Garantir integração de produtos e sistemas;
  • Auxiliar na validação de soluções técnicas;
  • Auxiliar na gestão, revisão e conclusão de pontos de auditorias;
  • Analisar e propor melhorias em relação a indicadores de ocorrências;
  • Assegurar o cumprimento de normas e padrões;
  • Acompanhar o processo de homologação de equipamentos e softwares de soluções externas visando a transformação e inovação;
  • Conduzir reuniões com equipes de trabalho;
  • Auxiliar no desenvolvimento e implementação de workshops e treinamentos voltados para a fomentação da transformação & inovação no âmbito da seguradora.

Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de seis (6) anos como Gerente de TI, com atuação comprovada em infraestrutura, redes e suporte (Service Desk), sendo desejável experiência no setor de seguros;
  • Vivência em projetos de transformação e simplificação digital de processos, gestão de mudanças e operações em seguros;
  • Experiência na definição de KPIs (tempos de resposta, resolução) e níveis de serviço (SLAs);

Nível de instrução

  • Superior em Sistemas de Informação, Tecnologia da Informação, Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas e/ou cursos afins;
  • MBA, Especialização ou Pós-Graduação em Gestão de TI, Transformação & Inovação e/ou áreas afins.

Cursos/Certificações/Conhecimentos específicos

  • Experiência em Gestão de Projetos e Metodologia Agile;
  • ITIL Foundation ou Superior (crucial para governança de serviços);
  • PMP ou metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban);

Fluência em francês ou espanhol

Competências

Liderança de equipes técnicas, excelente comunicação, capacidade de trabalhar em ambiente multidisciplinar, dinâmico e sob pressão (especialmente em momentos de crises, como DR e Alta Disponibilidade), visão sistêmica, visão estratégica de negócio, tomada de decisão, negociação, organização, raciocínio lógico e resiliência.

title: Analista de Compliance Senior
description:
Descrição da vaga

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente otimização de processos operacionais e soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único.

Analista de Compliance Senior você irá atuar na execução e no aprimoramento contínuo das iniciativas de Compliance da Companhia, com foco em gestão de riscos, controles internos, certificações e iniciativas de mercado, governança e suporte às áreas de negócio.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Garantir a adequada implementação dos Programas de Compliance, incluindo os temas de integridade e direitos humanos, por meio da condução de avaliações de riscos de processos, acompanhamento de controles e monitoramento de indicadores de eficácia, assegurando aderência à Lei Anticorrupção (Lei nº 12.846/13 e Decreto nº 11.129/22), à legislação de prevenção à lavagem de dinheiro (Lei nº 9.613/98), às obrigações regulatórias aplicáveis, às boas práticas de governança corporativa, às diretrizes de direitos humanos e às principais referências internacionais, como FCPA (EUA) e UK Bribery Act (Reino Unido).
  • Atuar em interface com as áreas da Companhia, apoiando iniciativas e projetos, com visão orientada ao negócio e à gestão de riscos, contribuindo para a viabilização das operações com segurança, aderência às normas e tomada de decisão responsável.
  • Apoiar a elaboração, revisão e aprimoramento de políticas, normas e procedimentos, assegurando sua aderência às exigências regulatórias e promovendo a melhoria contínua e a eficiência dos processos da Companhia, com fortalecimento do ambiente de controle.
  • Preparar materiais e evidências para auditorias internas, externas e projetos, bem como apoiar o mapeamento, avaliação e testes de controles de compliance em processos críticos, executando walkthroughs e testes de amostragem, garantindo a qualidade, consistência e tempestividade das entregas.
  • Apoiar a análise e resposta a consultas relacionadas aos temas de Compliance (doações e patrocínios, brindes e hospitalidade, conflito de interesses, contratações…), sob a ótica de riscos de integridade, reputacionais e regulatórios, elaborando pareceres de compliance e orientando as áreas quanto às salvaguardas e aos controles aplicáveis.
  • Acompanhar, analisar e reportar indicadores (KPI's) do Programa de Compliance.
  • Apoiar a elaboração de reports internos de Compliance.
  • Apoiar as áreas na elaboração de reportes externos, como o Formulário de Referência (CVM) e o Relatório de Sustentabilidade.
  • Apoiar a execução do programa de gestão de riscos de compliance, incluindo a atualização do Mapa de Riscos e Controles, com base em frameworks de gestão de riscos.
  • Realizar testes periódicos de controles internos, avaliando a aderência aos processos, ao desenho e à efetividade dos controles, conforme a matriz de riscos, bem como elaborar e acompanhar os planos de ação decorrentes dos resultados obtidos.
  • Conduzir e monitorar processos de due diligence de terceiros (fornecedores, clientes, embarcações, patrocínios, doações, entre outros), com base na metodologia e abordagem de risco da Companhia, incluindo, quando aplicável, critérios de avaliação como análise de estrutura societária, identificação de beneficiários finais, verificação de exposição a sanções internacionais e avaliação de histórico reputacional, em linha com referências internacionais como FCPA (EUA), UK Bribery Act (Reino Unido) e regimes de sanções (OFAC, União Europeia), com elaboração de pareceres de compliance e registro estruturado das informações, garantindo a consistência das avaliações e o suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Apoiar a gestão do Canal de Integridade.
  • Apoiar e conduzir treinamentos de compliance para áreas da Companhia.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação acadêmica, graduação em Direito, Administração ou áreas correlatas; desejável pós‑graduação em Compliance, Governança ou Gestão de Riscos.
  • Certificações desejáveis CCEP, CPC‑A; auditor/implementer ISO 37001/37301 e certificações em gestão de riscos (como ISO 31000 ou certificações correlatas).
  • Conhecimentos específicos sólidos em Due diligence de Integridade, na Lei nº 12.846/2013 e no Decreto nº 11.129/2022, com familiaridade com legislações internacionais anticorrupção e antissuborno, como FCPA (EUA) e UK Bribery Act (Reino Unido), bem como com regimes de sanções internacionais (ex.: OFAC, União Europeia) e diretrizes e referências nacionais e internacionais aplicáveis, incluindo o Programa de Integridade da CGU e as diretrizes da OCDE; experiência em controles internos, matriz de riscos e indicadores (KRIs e KPIs), incluindo vivência em avaliações de maturidade de programas de integridade (ex.: Pró‑Ética e Ethos).
  • Conhecimento em proteção de dados e privacidade (LGPD), e desejável familiaridade com a regulação aplicável ao setor de óleo e gás (ANP).
  • Ferramentas e sistemas: conhecimento em ferramentas de produtividade, análise de dados e automação, incluindo uso de inteligência artificial aplicada ao trabalho, automação de tarefas (ex.: Power Automate) e elaboração de dashboards (ex.: Power BI), bem como familiaridade com Python (desejável) e com ferramentas de due diligence de integridade.
  • Idiomas: Inglês avançado desejável.

description:
Overview

Desde dezembro de 2024 a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Cardoso Fontes. O Hospital Cardoso Fontes é direcionado ao atendimento de média e alta complexidade. É uma das principais referências hospitalares da Zona Oeste do Rio de Janeiro. A unidade é reconhecida por sua atuação na área de fisioterapia oncológica, ginecologia, nefrologia (sistema urinário) e tratamentos em crianças com insuficiência renal, pneumologia e urologia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar atividades da especialidade de pneumologia, conforme diretrizes da Instituição, Ministério da Saúde e Secretaria Municipal da Saúde.

  • Realizar consulta e atendimento médico, anamnese, exame físico, propedêutica instrumental;
  • Interpretar dados de exame clínico e exames complementares e diagnosticar estado de saúde;
  • Discutir diagnóstico, prognóstico, tratamento e prevenção com usuários, responsáveis e familiares;
  • Planejar e prescrever tratamento e praticar intervenções clínicas e cirúrgicas quando couber;
  • Prescrever medicamentos, hemoderivados e cuidados especiais;
  • Implementar ações para promoção da saúde, elaborar e avaliar prontuários, emitir receitas;
  • Participar de equipes interdisciplinares e multiprofissionais, realizando atividades em conjunto, tais como: discussão de casos, reuniões administrativas, matriciamento, entre outras;
  • Participar, conforme a política interna da Secretaria Municipal da Saúde (SMS), de projetos, cursos, eventos, comissões, convênios e programas de ensino, pesquisa e extensão;
  • Elaborar relatórios e laudos técnicos em sua área de especialidade;
  • Participar de programa de treinamento, quando convocado;
  • Trabalhar segundo normas técnicas de segurança, qualidade, produtividade, higiene e preservação ambiental;
  • Executar tarefas pertinentes à área de atuação, utilizando-se de equipamentos e programas de informática;
  • Estar em consonância com as diretrizes de práticas médicas baseadas em evidências publicadas;
  • Preencher adequadamente e de forma legível todos os formulários padronizados pelo serviço manualmente ou de forma digital;

description:
Com experiência em gestão de negócios desde 1955, a WLM atua de forma estratégica e integrada nos segmentos automotivo, do agronegócio, de energia e de soluções sustentáveis, consolidando-se como um grupo sólido, diversificado e em constante evolução.

O principal foco dos negócios da WLM é a comercialização de produtos e serviços da marca Scania, incluindo caminhões pesados e extrapesados, chassis para ônibus rodoviários e urbanos, venda de peças genuínas, além da prestação de serviços de manutenção corretiva e preventiva e assistência técnica especializada.

No segmento de concessionárias Scania , a WLM está presente em mais de 20 pontos no país, atendendo seis estados brasileiros, por meio das operações Equipo (RJ), Itaipu (MG), Itaipu Norte (PA), Quinta Roda (SP) eSupermac(AM e RR) .

No segmento do agronegócio , por meio de suas controladas Fartura (Sul do Pará) e Itapura (Norte do Mato Grosso, Sul de Minas e região de Campinas/SP) , a WLM atua nas atividades de cria, recria e engorda de bovinos, além da produção e comercialização de café, soja e milho. Com forte compromisso com a sustentabilidade, suas atividades produtivas são executadas com foco nas melhores práticas de preservação da fauna e flora nativas, bem como no cuidado com a água e o solo.

Em 2025, a WLM anunciou a aquisição de 60% da CHP Brasil , empresa referência em geração distribuída e eficiência energética. Com essa aquisição, o grupo amplia sua presença estratégica, diversifica seu portfólio e dá um passo significativo em direção ao futuro, reforçando seu compromisso com a sustentabilidade e com a criação de novas oportunidades de negócio no setor de energia.

Como parte dessa estratégia de inovação, sustentabilidade e diversificação dos negócios, nasce a EkoTruck , uma startup criada dentro do Grupo WLM com o propósito de oferecer sempre a melhor solução em peças e serviços para seus clientes. A empresa expande o foco do grupo por meio da reciclagem de caminhões, da oferta de peças alternativas, componentes remanufaturados e contratos de manutenção, com forte uso de tecnologia. Seu foco principal está na redução do TCO (Custo Total de Propriedade) dos clientes, no fortalecimento da economia circular e na geração de eficiência operacional sustentável.

A localização estratégica das unidades da WLM permite uma atuação com ampla cobertura geográfica, garantindo agilidade, qualidade e excelência no atendimento.

Company Description

M3 USA is at the forefront of healthcare innovation, offering digital solutions across healthcare, life sciences, pharmaceuticals, and more. Since our inception in 2000, we’ve seen remarkable growth, fueled by our mission to utilize the internet for a healthier world and more efficient healthcare systems.

Joining M3 USA means being part of a dedicated team striving to make a significant difference in healthcare. We provide a unique opportunity for you to be at the cutting edge of healthcare innovation, shaping the future in a meaningful career. Embrace the chance to drive change with M3 USA.

Due to our continued growth, we are hiring for a Senior Software Engineer - Node.JS at M3 Global Research , an M3 company.

About The Business Unit

M3 Global Research, part of M3 Inc., provides the most comprehensive and highest quality market research recruitment and support services available to the industry with relationships reaching respondents in more than 70 countries worldwide.

M3 Global Research maintains ISO 20252 and 27001 certifications, delivering high‑quality data collection and project management capabilities covering quantitative and qualitative techniques.

Job Description

M3 Global Research, an M3 company, is looking for a Senior Software Engineer who can thrive in a fast‑paced environment developing complex applications. The candidate will demonstrate an understanding of software development concepts, lifecycles using Agile methodologies, object‑oriented design, and accepted design patterns and practices. Responsibilities include

  • Lead and supervise the development team, ensuring projects are executed efficiently, aligned with Agile methodologies, and meet quality standards.
  • Design, implement, and deliver highly scalable solutions based on modern cloud‑based architecture.
  • Continuously develop, release, monitor, and improve our systems and services while fostering a culture of accountability.
  • Set and promote software development processes and best practices, providing mentorship to team members.
  • Participate in and facilitate Agile ceremonies, such as daily stand‑ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.
  • Provide regular status updates to stakeholders, ensuring transparency and clear communication of progress, roadblocks, and timelines.
  • Partner with product managers, designers, and engineers across the organization to shape high‑impact solutions and deliver high‑quality applications.
  • Take responsibility for the team’s deliverables, ensuring scope is maintained and work is delivered iteratively while embracing Agile principles.

Qualifications

  • Strong expertise in Node.js, with experience building scalable and efficient backend systems and APIs.
  • Knowledge of SQL and familiarity with relational databases such as Oracle.
  • Experience with modern front‑end frameworks, specifically React or Angular, and familiarity with Bootstrap for UI development.
  • Exposure to additional languages and frameworks such as PL/SQL, Java/JSP, jQuery, HTML5, CSS3, PHP, Ruby, and ColdFusion is beneficial.
  • Proficient with source control tools like Git for collaborative development and versioning.
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and familiarity with standards like OWASP Top Ten and SANS CWE, with a commitment to adapting to evolving security threats.
  • Team‑oriented with exceptional collaboration and communication skills, both verbal and written.
  • Exceptional multitasking abilities, capable of balancing multiple projects and priorities effectively.
  • An analytical mindset with superior problem‑solving abilities and a strong inclination to learn and implement new techniques.
  • Familiarity with mobile‑first development and responsive design is a plus.

AI and Automation Expectations

  • Strong hands‑on experience with modern AI models and coding tools that improve development velocity and software quality.
  • Ability to apply AI across the Node.js lifecycle, including implementation, refactoring, debugging, and unit/integration test creation.
  • Experience using AI to strengthen CI/CD and quality engineering practices (test generation, flaky test analysis, release validation, and review support).
  • Proven ability to design or integrate automation that increases team efficiency, reduces repetitive work, and improves delivery consistency.
  • Practical understanding of model selection, prompt strategy, output validation, and safe handling of proprietary or sensitive information.
  • Evidence of measurable outcomes from AI‑enabled engineering (faster delivery cycles, stronger test posture, and reduced production defects).

Additional Information

  • Applicants located in Brazil who are willing to work US EST hours.

title: Especialista de Inteligência e Relacionamento com Autoridades - Rio de Janeiro (RJ)
description:
Por que a Gabriel?

16.500 câmeras. 90 milhões de leituras de placa por mês. 1 alerta por minuto direto para a polícia. 650+ suspeitos indiciados. No Rio, nossa rede protege bairros inteiros com tecnologia integrada às forças policiais. Aqui você não apenas trabalha com tecnologia, você transforma dados em vidas protegidas e reduz a impunidade em cidades onde a segurança é direito de todos.

Por que essa vaga existe?

Nossa operação no Rio processa alto volume de demandas de delegacias, batalhões e guarda municipal. Absorver esse volume com agilidade, sem comprometer qualidade, é o desafio central dessa posição. Você será responsável por analisar ocorrências em tempo real, preparar evidências que aceleram investigações e garantir que cada alerta chega à polícia registrado, rastreável e pronto para ação.

Como a Gabriel remunera?

  • Nossa Remuneração: de R$150.800 a R$226.200 /ano (incluindo 13º salário e férias)
  • Nossos Benefícios (mais de R$35.000 anuais em benefícios):
    • Cuidado completo com a sua Saúde de maneira integral:
    • Plano de Saúde Alice com atendimento 24h pelo app, cobertura nacional e acesso a hospitais de referência no país - e sem coparticipação para os colaboradores. Cobrimos também 80% do valor dos seus dependentes.
    • Plano Odontológico da Odontoprev, para cuidar do seu sorriso e dos seus dependentes sem coparticipação.
    • Totalpass TP+1 custeado integralmente para você - para quem corre, caminha, "puxa ferro", faz yoga ou quem quer começar a se cuidar. Você pode adicionar até três dependentes.
    • Reembolso Saúde Mental: para cuidar também da sua saúde mental, reembolsamos até R$ 100,00 por sessão de psicoterapia.
    • Alimentação: Cada refeição importa, e a gente sabe. Oferecemos vale-refeição no Cartão Caju de R$ 922,00 por mês.
    • Benefício Educação: Seu crescimento impulsiona o nosso: reembolsamos 50% do valor que você investe na sua educação, limitado a até R$ 4.000/ano.
    • Auxílio Creche: Crianças de até 5 anos e 11 meses têm direito a auxílio-creche, para você poder focar no seu trabalho sabendo que quem você ama está bem cuidado.
    • Descanso de Aniversário, para você curtir sua data especial como preferir.

Responsabilidades principais

  • Análise de ocorrências é o coração do trabalho
    • Fornecer às autoridades competentes informações técnicas que aceleram investigações e ajudam a dar resposta concreta à sociedade - sem nunca substituir o trabalho investigativo, que é da autoridade pública;
    • Absorver alto volume de demandas simultâneas com agilidade, sem comprometer a qualidade - no RJ, o ritmo é intenso e a capacidade de priorização faz toda a diferença;
    • Acompanhar e registrar desfechos - cada suspeito indiciado, cada pessoa encontrada, cada caso resolvido com apoio das nossas imagens é uma métrica de impacto real.
  • Atendimento institucional a autoridades públicas
    • Atender demandas de delegacias, batalhões, Guardas Municipais e demais órgãos de segurança no RJ, recebendo e processando solicitações conforme os protocolos da empresa;
    • Apoiar o time existente na gestão do fluxo de atendimento, garantindo que o aumento de volume não comprometa prazos nem padrão de entrega;
    • Participar de Conselhos Comunitários de Segurança e espaços institucionais quando necessário, representando a Gabriel de forma transparente;
    • Reportar à liderança de Relações Institucionais e Governamentais, contribuindo com insumos operacionais para o planejamento da área.
  • Compliance como base de tudo
    • Garantir que toda interação com autoridades siga os protocolos formais da empresa: canais corporativos, ofício válido, registro em HubSpot, compartilhamento por link restrito;
    • Manter padrão de documentação que suporte auditoria - todas as comunicações são individualizadas, rastreáveis e revisadas periodicamente.
  • Colaboração com o time
    • Trabalhar junto ao time do RJ e à Central 24h, garantindo fluidez entre os casos que chegam por diferentes canais;
    • Contribuir com melhorias nos processos operacionais - quem está na linha de frente com volume alto é quem melhor enxerga gargalos e oportunidades;
    • Capacitar equipes internas quando necessário, compartilhando conhecimento sobre dinâmicas de segurança e boas práticas de análise.

O que esperamos de você

  • Experiência comprovada em análise de ocorrências, análise de vídeos ou avaliação de riscos em contexto de segurança;
  • Experiência em interação com autoridades públicas de segurança (Polícia Civil, Polícia Militar, Guarda Municipal ou equivalentes), com atuação pautada por protocolos formais;
  • Capacidade analítica forte e habilidade de priorizar sob pressão com alto volume de demandas simultâneas - esse é o diferencial central da posição;
  • Agilidade na execução sem perda de qualidade: a pessoa precisa ser rápida e precisa ao mesmo tempo;
  • Comunicação excelente, tanto escrita (documentação, relatórios, devolutivas a autoridades) quanto oral (interação com delegacias e times internos);
  • Proficiência em ferramentas de análise e edição de vídeo;
  • Segundo grau completo; bacharelado em Gestão de Riscos, Gestão de Segurança, Direito, Engenharia ou áreas afins será um diferencial.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência prévia com análise de imagens de videomonitoramento;
  • Experiência em ambiente operacional de segurança com alto volume;
  • Conhecimento do CRM HubSpot;
  • Experiência com melhoria de processos e fluxos operacionais;
  • Conhecimento do ecossistema de segurança pública do Rio de Janeiro.

Mais informações

  • Modelo de contratação: presencial
  • Localização: Centro, Rio de Janeiro - RJ

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

Reporting organizationally to the Accommodation Manager in Rio de Janeiro, the Accommodation Coordinator will help serve Accommodation efforts for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ is hosting 32 teams and 700+ players across Brazil and 8 host cities/ venues. This role will be responsible for coordinating lodging and hotel-related arrangements for the event, ensuring a smooth and comfortable experience for teams, participants and attendees. Further, this role will have a range of responsibilities, including contracting hotels, coordinating inventory, F&B, AV, meetings space, and reconciling and reporting.

  • Provide resources and information to guests, create presentation materials
  • Support booking and reservation processes for guests
  • Keep all necessary internal and external reporting up to date
  • Ensure held inventory is in accordance with remaining demand
  • Attend site visits, familiarize with hotels and tour constituent groups
  • Coordinate the reconciliation, billing and closeout at hotels and with groups
  • Support and address unforeseen changes, cancellations, or emergencies in accommodation arrangements
  • Build strong relationships with designated groups to provide excellent experience within the overall accommodation strategy
  • Consider all operational aspects when coordinating hotel arrangements, for example, transportation, logistics, security, etc.
  • Uphold and enforce high standards of customer service, ensuring participants and guests have a memorable and enjoyable experience during their stay
  • Establish relationships with the hotel industry to provide the best overall value for FIFA
  • Ensure records of accommodation bookings, rooming lists, and related information comply with data integrity and protection regulations
  • Coordinate various ancillary projects taking place in the leadup to the Women’s World Cup

Your Profile

  • Bachelor’s Degree or similar level of education.

Requirements

  • Must have legal right to work in Brazil.
  • Ability to relocate and work from Rio de Janeiro.
  • Required language skills: fluent in English and Portuguese is mandatory, fluent in Spanish is a big plus.

title: Deal Executive (Brazil)
description:
Sobre a Duetti

A Duetti está redefinindo a forma como criadores independentes de música monetizam e expandem suas carreiras. Fundada em 2022 pelo CEO Lior Tibon e pelo COO Christopher Nolte, a Duetti faz parcerias com criadores para destravar o valor de seus catálogos por meio de acordos flexíveis e transparentes, ao mesmo tempo em que oferece serviços de alto nível de gestão de catálogo, distribuição e marketing. Desde sua fundação, a Duetti já firmou parceria com mais de 1.100 criadores de música em 40 países, incluindo Connor Price, Ingrid Contreras e Brent Morgan, ajudando-os a monetizar suas músicas em seus próprios termos e alcançar novos públicos.

Apoiando-se em investidores de destaque como The Raine Group, Flexpoint Ford, Nyca Partners, Viola Ventures e Roc Nation, a Duetti já levantou mais de US$ 635 milhões em capital para financiar criadores independentes. Impulsionada pela crença na independência e no empoderamento financeiro, a Duetti está construindo um futuro mais sustentável para criadores de música em todo o mundo. Com escritórios em Nova York, Los Angeles, Miami e Londres, a Duetti oferece benefícios competitivos, política flexível de folgas remuneradas e um modelo de trabalho híbrido. Temos orgulho de uma cultura que combina ambição com cuidado genuíno — um ambiente onde o seu trabalho impacta diretamente os resultados para artistas ao redor do mundo.

Descrição da Vaga

Como Deal Executive na Duetti, você estará no centro da nossa missão voltada aos artistas, atuando como um elo fundamental com nossos artistas parceiros e suas equipes. Você trabalhará lado a lado com os gerentes de A&R da Duetti em nossos acordos mais estratégicos e complexos, garantindo que eles atendam tanto aos objetivos da empresa quanto aos dos artistas.

Você terá um papel essencial na formulação e execução da estratégia de A&R da Duetti, colaborando de perto com a liderança sênior da empresa. Sua atuação ficará na interseção entre Música, Operações e Análise de Dados, contribuindo diretamente para a missão da Duetti de democratizar a monetização de catálogos musicais.

Você irá:
  • Trabalhar em parceria com o time de A&R da Duetti para negociar e executar nossos acordos mais complexos e de atendimento altamente personalizado, diretamente com nossos artistas parceiros e suas equipes, além de desenvolver soluções criativas para os desafios encontrados pelo time de A&R.
  • Desenvolver e cultivar relacionamentos com artistas, empresários e outros agentes da indústria.
  • Apoiar o time de A&R no alcance de metas e marcos ambiciosos em um ambiente dinâmico e acelerado.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para garantir a execução e integração fluida dos acordos.
  • Utilizar análise de dados para identificar oportunidades de aumentar a eficiência ao longo do ciclo de vendas.
  • Manter-se atualizado sobre tendências do setor, estratégias de concorrentes e tecnologias emergentes no espaço de fintech musical.
Requisitos:
  • Mais de 3 anos de experiência comprovada em vendas ou desenvolvimento de negócio em uma empresa de música ou fintech.
  • Forte compreensão da indústria musical e capacidade de interpretar estruturas contratuais complexas.
  • Entendimento de contratos e acordos.
  • Atenção comprovada aos detalhes, forte ética de trabalho e entusiasmo para atuar em um startup em estágio inicial, que exige pessoas proativas e solucionadoras de problemas.
  • Paixão por música e cultura, além do desejo de estar na linha de frente de novos modelos de negócio para artistas.
  • Capacidade de liderar, colaborar e trabalhar de forma autônoma em um ambiente dinâmico de startup, com atitude positiva e proativa.

title: Transport Client Services Manager
description:
Transport Client Services Manager

Department: Tournament and Venue Operations

Employment Type: Fixed Term - Full Time

Location: Brazil

Description

FIFA has established a Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil to work together with FIFA Zurich to deliver the biggest women’s sporting event in the world, the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027™ (“FWWC2027”) that for the first time ever, is hosted in South America in Brazil. Now is your time to be part of the workforce that is creating this unique and unforgettable experience.

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

THE POSITION

The Transport Client Services Manager role exists both tactical (pre‑Tournament) and operationally (Tournament time) – shifting from planning & relationship management to execution & issue resolution.

The Transport Client Service Manager is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, and delivery of transport services for designated client groups during FWWC2027. Acting as the primary liaison between the Transport Functional Area and key stakeholders (such as FIFA Constituent Groups including; Teams, Referees, FIFA Senior Officials, Delegates and Guests, Workforce, Media & Broadcast and Commercial Affiliates), the role ensures that client transport requirements are accurately captured, planned, and operationally delivered in alignment with the FIFA Transport Operating Concept.

During the pre‑Tournament phase, the Manager oversees client engagement, gathers and validates detailed mobility requirements, and translates these into Service Level Agreements (SLAs). The role is responsible for delivering the Detailed Service Level Agreements (DSLAs) according to agreed timelines and for gaining the necessary agreements and approvals, ensuring that the role works cross‑functionally with fleet planning, Venue and Arrivals and Departures Teams to ensure feasibility, readiness, and service alignment. The position also contributes to test events, readiness exercises, and data accuracy.

During Tournament time, the Transport Client Service Manager becomes the operational lead for assigned client groups, monitoring service performance, managing daily communications, resolving issues in real time, and coordinating adjustments from the Transport Operations Center. The role is accountable for maintaining service reliability, managing escalations, and ensuring a high level of client satisfaction in a fast‑paced, high‑pressure environment.

In addition to the above, the role will provide support for the following Event Transport sub‑projects planning and implementation:

  • Developing Transport policies, procedures, Operational Plan and reports.
  • To build, train and motivate the Client Services team of paid staff and volunteers for the duration of the FWWC2027 Tournament.

The successful candidate is expected to be a self‑starter and multitasker who works well under pressure, can lead and manage a team and delivers to strict timelines.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Recruit, manage and lead a team of Client Service.
  • Coordinate the transport and arrivals and departures service planning for each client group as named above to ensure the correct services, in accordance with FIFA service levels are planned for each client group to ensure the overall success of the tournament.
  • Liaison, in coordination with other transport stakeholders, with all transport mode suppliers including bus, fleet and public transport and other key functional areas to develop the services.
  • Direct the delivery of the Detailed Service Level Agreements (DSLAs), per client group. Ensure all agreements and necessary approvals are gained with client owners, transport service delivery functions both internal to FWWC2027 and external partners / suppliers and FIFA.
  • Lead the client services team to ensure all client service level planning is integrated with other key FWWC2027 functional areas at site and venue level including all stadiums and non‑competition sites.
  • Lead on ensuring the DSLAs are fully integrated with all concerned stakeholders.
  • Work closely with other transport team members (Bus, Fleet and Venues) to ensure the most efficient services are planned and delivered for each client group in line with agreed budgets.
  • Always with the aim of delivering the best client experience and optimising efficiencies where possible.
  • Lead on the delivery of all clients related information, communications and presentations at key client meetings plus any client transport guides/information and other related documents, both electronic and published.
  • Lead on the planning, staffing and management of VIP and FIFA hotels operations including planning of all resources and the recruitment and training of transport desk staff.
  • Support delivery of Transport for all test events prior to the FWWC2027.
  • Work with Senior Transport Management team to prepare risk analysis and develop mitigation strategies for each client group.
  • Act as the primary transport liaison for assigned client groups, maintaining daily engagement and providing operational updates.
  • Monitor transport service performance (fleet allocation, on‑time performance, demand vs. capacity) and initiate real‑time adjustments as required.
  • Manage and resolve operational issues, delays, last‑minute schedule changes, and escalations affecting client transport services.
  • Oversee major peak movements, including arrivals, departures, and high‑profile competition or ceremony transport waves.
  • Provide daily reporting on service levels, incidents, and client feedback, ensuring transparency and continuous operational improvement.
  • Safeguard client satisfaction while ensuring services remain aligned with approved entitlements and operational constraints.

YOUR PROFILE

Qualifications

  • Education – Bachelor’s Degree in Transport/Logistics/Civil Engineering/Project management/Event Management or a combination of education and experience relating to position. Master’s Degree is an additional asset.
  • Minimum of eight (8) years of event transport experience in international major events in at least two (2) world‑class sport/football events. E.g. FIFA World Cup/Olympic Games/Expo. Experience should include solid experience in multiple aspects of event transport operations and project management.
  • Minimum of five (5) years of management experience in a similar role within an organising committee leading large teams to deliver a time critical project.
  • Proven experience of successfully managing and delivering transport projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Proven experience of managing fleet services and operations projects of a similar size and scale.
  • Experience working with public and private sector partners in a collaborative environment and ability to build strong partnerships.

Skills

  • Advanced knowledge of administration and management principles.
  • Advanced knowledge of teams’ leadership, business process management.
  • Advanced communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills, the ability to influence others and manage relationships.
  • Ability to design, implement and operate a transport system in the Brazilian event environment.
  • Knowledge of Event Transportation technical operating processes and activities.
  • Ability to motivate others toward a common goal and manage a multidisciplinary team through conflicting priorities and continuous change requests.
  • Ability to work and communicate in a corporate and project focused organisation.
  • Proven project management skills within a complex project.

title: WHS Program Manager, WHS Implementation Management
description:
WHS Program Manager, WHS Implementation Management

At Amazon, we're working to be the most customer-centric company, to be best employer, and be safest place to work on earth. To get there, we need exceptionally talented, bright, and driven people. If you'd like to help us build that place, this is your chance to make history.

One focus area of the Amazon Workplace Health & Safety Brazil (BR WHS) is to provide tools, resources, and environments that support safe, efficient, and healthy behaviors and encourage employees to proactively manage their health and wellbeing. To support this focus area, Amazon is seeking an experienced and innovative person to serve as Program Manager for BR WHS to build and execute programs that create a safe workplace and build a world‑class safety culture in the midst of Amazon's growth. In this role, responsibilities include diving deep into Operations processes; identifying risks through data and first‑hand experience; building and executing programs, and improving processes to eliminate risks; and influencing Operations to sustain a culture of safety. This role will focus on coordinating and leading large, strategic projects and programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs) and will be strongly focused on injury and accident prevention as well as improvements across health, safety and wellness.

The WHS Program Manager role will challenge the individual to push boundaries and lead transformative innovation while having the autonomy to make rapid data‑driven decisions. In this role, cross‑functional work with members from various teams will be required, including Operations; Learning, ACEs, WHS, and OpEx to deploy solutions at scale. This role calls for an individual who is technically smart to gain credibility with customers and stakeholders at various levels of the organization.

The ideal candidate has an obsession for customers and a strong interest in building innovative solutions; must have proven analytical capabilities (including ability to deep dive, identify root causes and permanently eliminate hazards and risks); and can thrive in a fast‑paced environment with exceptional communication and project management skills. The ideal candidate must have excellent judgment, compassion, and interpersonal skills with the ability to work collaboratively with colleagues in many areas across the company.

Key job responsibilities

  • Development, review, approval, coordination, and leadership of large, strategic projects and programs within Amazon Business Units (BUs).
  • Relationships and partnerships across many organizations must be built to execute new initiatives and roadmaps each year.
  • Collaboration with stakeholders and partners to align on project and program goals and resources must be maintained.
  • A portfolio of programs and projects from inception to delivery must be coordinated. These may also be global in nature.
  • Metrics to measure and communicate Brazil program achievements must be defined and implemented.
  • Program decision support, insights, and recommendations through data gathering and information analysis must be provided.
  • Leadership of programs designed to standardize safety processes across business units must be demonstrated.
  • Business‑critical decisions that enable scalability and deliver industry‑leading performance must be influenced.
  • Processes must be benchmarked with Worldwide Workplace Health and Safety to continuously raise customer experience standards.
  • Program improvements and initiatives must be driven in close collaboration with Workplace Health and Safety business leaders and field and program teams.
  • New safety methods and processes across Brazil operations must be piloted.
  • Large‑scale, business‑critical problems through strategic projects and programs must be solved.

Basic Qualifications

  • Speak, write, and read fluently in English.
  • Experience with analytical tools and ability to dive deep into metrics and reporting.
  • Experience leading and interacting with cross‑functional teams.
  • Experience managing medium to large‑scale projects.
  • Bachelor’s Degree.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Degree in a health and safety‑related subject.
  • Master's degree in Engineering or Business Administration or a related field.
  • Knowledge of Lean Manufacturing & Continuous Improvement principles & techniques.

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

  • E outras atividades de caldeiraria não contempladas na relação acima.

(Senior / Lead Individual Contributor – Multi‑Track Job Posting)

About This Job Posting

This job posting is designed to attract senior-level software developers, data professionals, and technical specialists to join Landmark, where we build and evolve platforms and complex systems operating on a global scale.

This is a technology‑first opportunity, focused on deep technical challenges related to system architecture, scalability, performance, data, and reliability — far beyond standard application development.

This is one job posting covering multiple technical tracks (roles). Candidates must select the technical track that best matches their background when applying. Mandatory application questions will guide this selection.

What You Will Work On

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain complex software platforms and systems
  • Work on large‑scale, distributed, and performance‑sensitive applications
  • Contribute to system architecture and technical decision‑making
  • Build and integrate services using APIs, microservices, and complex data flows
  • Improve performance, scalability, security, and reliability
  • Apply modern engineering practices including CI/CD, automation, cloud, and Agile
  • Collaborate with global, cross‑functional teams
  • Act as a senior technical contributor or lead individual contributor
  • Continuously expand your technical skills and system‑level expertise

Technical Tracks Covered by This Posting

Track 1 – Full Stack Developer (Web & Cloud Platforms)

For developers focused on modern, scalable software platforms.

Typical focus areas:

  • Frontend development with Angular (v12+), TypeScript, HTML, CSS
  • Backend services using Node.js, REST APIs, microservices
  • Cloud‑native development on Azure and/or AWS
  • Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • SQL and NoSQL databases

Track 2 – Platform Developer – Performance & Optimization

For developers passionate about efficiency, performance, and system optimization.

Typical focus areas:

  • Observability, scalability, and reliability engineering

Track 3 – Software Developer (C++ / Complex Systems)

Typical focus areas:

  • Development in C++ (MFC experience strongly valued)
  • Performance‑critical and system‑level applications
  • Object‑oriented design and low‑level problem solving
  • Integration with databases, APIs, and external services
  • Working with complex legacy and modernized systems

Track 4 – Technical Developer – Quality, Validation & System Behavior

For technically strong profiles focused on system correctness and reliability.

Typical focus areas:

  • Validation and quality assurance of complex software or data‑driven systems
  • Designing test strategies for advanced platforms and workflows
  • Understanding system behavior, edge cases, and failure scenarios

This is not traditional manual QA. It suits developers or technical specialists who enjoy deep system understanding and validation.

What We Are Looking For (Across All Tracks)

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Computer Science, Software, Systems, or Engineering disciplines, or Data Science, Mathematics, Physics, or related fields
  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development or technical roles
  • Strong foundations in problem solving, system design, and software fundamentals
  • Experience working on complex, non‑trivial systems
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in distributed, cross‑functional teams

Job titles and academic backgrounds may vary — what matters is deep technical experience, system‑level thinking, and alignment with one of the defined technical tracks.

Why Join Landmark

  • Solve challenging technical problems with real‑world impact
  • Collaborate with experienced engineers and developers globally
  • Exposure to advanced architectures, performance challenges, and large‑scale data
  • Strong culture of learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence
  • Clear growth paths for technical experts and lead contributors

Location & Work Model

  • This opportunity supports long‑term, ongoing initiatives within our platform and systems environment.

This job posting is intentionally broad and flexible, allowing us to attract talent from diverse technical backgrounds while matching candidates to the most relevant team through technical track selection.

description:
Job Description

The Finance Manager is responsible for daily oversight and monitoring of the finance and accounting activities assigned to themselves and/or their team. Additionally, the Finance Manager provides guidance, training, and consultation to employees and finance team members regarding their specific financial services and recruitment of staff as needed. Managers may also be responsible for the maintenance and administration of financial accounting systems supporting their assigned function and maintenance of processes and internal controls within their assigned area.

What You Will Do

  • Preparation of periodic budgets and forecasts for the Region(s).
  • Guides in the preparation of statutory accounts and tax returns for ABS and its subsidiary companies.
  • Guide in the preparation of returns relating to personal property, license, annual reports and other miscellaneous returns for ABS and its subsidiary companies.
  • Coordination and administration of external audits.
  • Provide in-depth analysis and reporting of financial information to senior management for purposes of making informed decisions and evaluating performance.
  • Maintain relationships with important vendors, service providers and business partners.
  • Participate in cross functional and/or multi-jurisdictional teams and projects across the ABS organization as needed.
  • Train, supervise, provide guidance, and coordinate the work of the financial staff while assuming accountability for service delivery.
  • Collaborate within the ABS organization to identify and resolve business issues.
  • Drive value and efficiency in assigned processes while minimizing risk and cost.
  • Maintain an effective internal controls environment by ensuring that FSG Policy and Procedural Statements are adhered to in assigned area. Drive the FSG strategy by identifying and implementing innovative solutions and services to improve and simplify processes.

What You Will Need

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or recognized equivalent in accounting or finance.
  • A minimum of seven (7) years' previous accounting and tax experience in an international service or manufacturing company environment, with some experience in a financial management position.

Knowledge, Skills And Abilities

  • Disciplined in relevant accounting or financial concepts and principles.
  • Technically proficient with financial and accounting systems / software.
  • Capacity to analyze, interpret, and report financial data.
  • Good interpersonal skills for dealing with internal and external clients.
  • Good managerial skills in the areas of team leadership, development, organization, planning and implementation.
  • Knowledge of computerized accounting systems, preferably Oracle.
  • A thorough knowledge of ABS and its businesses and processes is also beneficial to providing maximum effectiveness in this position.
  • Obtain a working knowledge of the ABS Health, Safety, Quality & Environmental Management System.

Reporting Relationships

The incumbent reports directly to the Director of Finance. May have individual contributors report to them.

Equal Opportunity

title: Brazil OR Colombia - Hybrid: Senior Software Developer - Platform & Complex Systems
description:
We are looking for the right people — people who want to innovate, achieve, grow and lead. We attract and retain the best talent by investing in our employees and empowering them to develop themselves and their careers. Experience the challenges, rewards and opportunity of working for one of the world’s largest providers of products and services to the global energy industry.

Senior Software Developer – Platform & Complex Systems

Senior / Lead Individual Contributor – Multi‑Track Job Posting

About This Job Posting

This job posting is designed to attract senior‑level software developers, data professionals, and technical specialists to join Landmark, where we build and evolve platforms and complex systems operating on a global scale.

This is a technology‑first opportunity, focused on deep technical challenges related to system architecture, scalability, performance, data, and reliability — far beyond standard application development.

This is one job posting covering multiple technical tracks (roles). Candidates must select the technical track that best matches their background when applying. Mandatory application questions will guide this selection.

What You Will Work On

  • Design, develop, test, and maintain complex software platforms and systems
  • Work on large‑scale, distributed, and performance‑sensitive applications
  • Contribute to system architecture and technical decision‑making
  • Build and integrate services using APIs, microservices, and complex data flows
  • Improve performance, scalability, security, and reliability
  • Apply modern engineering practices including CI/CD, automation, cloud, and Agile
  • Collaborate with global, cross‑functional teams
  • Act as a senior technical contributor or lead individual contributor
  • Continuously expand your technical skills and system‑level expertise

Technical Tracks Covered by This Posting

Track 1 – Full Stack Developer (Web & Cloud Platforms)

For developers focused on modern, scalable software platforms.

Typical focus areas:

  • Frontend development with Angular (v12+), TypeScript, HTML, CSS
  • Backend services using Node.js, REST APIs, microservices
  • Cloud‑native development on Azure and/or AWS
  • Containerization and orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • SQL and NoSQL databases

Track 2 – Platform Developer – Performance & Optimization

For developers passionate about efficiency, performance, and system optimization.

Typical focus areas:

  • Full stack or backend development
  • Performance profiling and tuning of distributed systems
  • Kubernetes optimization and cloud resource efficiency
  • Cost‑aware architectural decisions
  • Observability, scalability, and reliability engineering

Track 3 – Software Developer (C++ / Complex Systems)

For developers working close to the core of high‑performance, engineering‑heavy software.

Typical focus areas:

  • Development in C++ (MFC experience strongly valued)
  • Performance‑critical and system‑level applications
  • Object‑oriented design and low‑level problem solving
  • Integration with databases, APIs, and external services
  • Working with complex legacy and modernized systems

Track 4 – Technical Developer – Quality, Validation & System Behavior

For technically strong profiles focused on system correctness and reliability.

Typical focus areas:

  • Validation and quality assurance of complex software or data‑driven systems
  • Designing test strategies for advanced platforms and workflows
  • Understanding system behavior, edge cases, and failure scenarios
  • Partnering closely with developers to improve system robustness

This is not traditional manual QA. It suits developers or technical specialists who enjoy deep system understanding and validation.

What We Are Looking For (Across All Tracks)

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in computer science, software, systems, engineering disciplines, data science, mathematics, physics, or related fields
  • 7+ years of professional experience in software development or technical roles
  • Strong foundations in problem solving, system design, and software fundamentals
  • Experience working on complex, non‑trivial systems
  • Ability to collaborate effectively in distributed, cross‑functional teams
  • Good communication skills in English
  • Motivation to grow as a senior or lead individual contributor

Job titles and academic backgrounds may vary — what matters is deep technical experience, system‑level thinking, and alignment with one of the defined technical tracks.

Why Join Landmark

  • Work on platforms and complex systems, not just features
  • Solve challenging technical problems with real‑world impact
  • Collaborate with experienced engineers and developers globally
  • Exposure to advanced architectures, performance challenges, and large‑scale data
  • Strong culture of learning, knowledge sharing, and technical excellence
  • Clear growth paths for technical experts and lead contributors

Location & Work Model

  • This posting is open to candidates based in Brazil or Colombia, with full collaboration across global teams
  • Hybrid (occasional on‑site collaboration, depending on team and project needs)
  • This opportunity supports long‑term, ongoing initiatives within our platform and systems environment
  • Specific project timelines may vary by technical track and team assignment and will be discussed during the interview process

Additional Information

This job posting is intentionally broad and flexible, allowing us to attract talent from diverse technical backgrounds while matching candidates to the most relevant team through technical track selection.

Reminder: Applicants must select their technical track as part of the application process so they can be considered for the appropriate role covered by this posting.

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II . A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade. Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público. O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras. Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Realizar a gestão de documentos e arquivos, elaborar relatórios e planilhas para análise de dados, apoiar atividades administrativas e facilitar a comunicação entre departamentos. Contribuir para a implementação de políticas administrativas, atender demandas internas e externas.

title: QA Engineer
description:
About Kestra

Kestra is the universal orchestration platform — open source, declarative, and designed to orchestrate data pipelines, IT automation, business workflows, and AI/agentic systems. Trusted by over 10,000 organizations worldwide — including JPMorgan Chase, Bloomberg, FILA, and Crédit Agricole — Kestra orchestrates mission‑critical workloads at scale. The open‑source project has close to 30,000 GitHub stars , hundreds of contributors, and a fast‑growing global community. In March 2026, we closed a $25M Series A led by RTP Global, with participation from Alven, ISAI, and Axeleo – backed by founders from Datadog, dbt Labs, and Hugging Face.

The Role

We’re looking for a QA Engineer based in Brazil to ensure the quality and reliability of Kestra’s platform across both the open‑source and Enterprise editions. A key part of this role involves working directly with customer support tickets: understanding reported issues, reproducing them in local or staging environments, and verifying fixes before they ship. You’ll be the bridge between what customers experience and what the engineering team delivers. This is a fully remote position. We’re hiring from Brazil for timezone alignment with the broader team.

What You’ll Do

  • Review and analyze customer support tickets to understand reported issues, extract reproduction steps, and translate customer‑reported problems into actionable bug reports for the engineering team.
  • Reproduce customer‑reported bugs across different environments and configurations, ensuring the engineering team has the context they need to fix issues efficiently.
  • Design, write, and maintain test plans and test cases covering both the open‑source platform and Enterprise Edition features.
  • Perform manual and exploratory testing for new features and regression testing for existing functionality across each release cycle.
  • Collaborate with engineers to define acceptance criteria, identify edge cases, and validate fixes before release.
  • Contribute to building and improving automated test coverage where applicable.
  • Track and report on quality metrics, test coverage, and recurring issue patterns to help the team prioritize improvements.

What We’re Looking For

  • Experience in software QA with a strong foundation in both manual and automated testing methodologies.
  • Ability to read and interpret customer support tickets, often with incomplete information, and systematically reproduce issues. This is central to the role.
  • Familiarity with infrastructure and orchestration concepts: Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines, or workflow automation tools. You’ll need this context to test effectively.
  • Comfortable working with APIs, reading logs, and navigating distributed systems to trace issues.
  • Experience writing automated tests (for instance, in Java, Python, or TypeScript) and working with test frameworks.
  • Strong written communication in English. You’ll collaborate with a globally distributed team and document issues clearly.
  • Self‑directed and detail‑oriented. You can prioritize across incoming support issues and planned test cycles without heavy oversight.

Bonus Points

  • Past experience in a QA role that involved direct interaction with customer‑reported issues or support escalations.
  • Experience with open‑source software or B2B SaaS platforms.
  • Familiarity with orchestration or workflow tools (Airflow, n8n, Terraform, Ansible, or similar).
  • Experience with performance testing or load testing for distributed systems.
  • Knowledge of Java (Kestra’s core is written in Java).

What You Get

  • Real ownership in a globally distributed, technical team.
  • Direct exposure to product strategy and company priorities.
  • A product used for mission‑critical workloads — not demos.
  • Competitive compensation, equity, and health insurance.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

  • Liderar aoriginação, modelagem,estruturação e execução de investimentosem infraestrutura, concessões e PPPs, atuando em todas as etapas do ciclo de investimento;
  • Coordenar equipes multidisciplinares (financeira, técnica, jurídica e regulatória) na condução de projetos complexos;

  • Elaborar e conduzir apresentações, casos de investimento, relatórios de acompanhamento a públicos-alvo diversificados;

  • Apoiar a definição de estratégias de portfólio e estruturação societária dos veículos de investimento;
  • Monitorar o desempenho operacional, financeiro e ESG das empresas investidas e projetos em estruturação, contribuindo para a geração de valor e mitigação de riscos;
  • Atuar ativamente na formação e desenvolvimento de analistas e associados, promovendo a excelência técnica e o alinhamento cultural com os valores da Vinci Compass.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação superior em Engenharia, Economia, Administração ou áreas correlatas;
  • Experiência mínima de 8 a 10 anos em investimentos em infraestrutura, ou Project Finance;
  • Mestrado, Doutorado, MBA ou pós-graduação em Finanças, Economia ou áreas afins será considerado um grande diferencial;
  • Domínio da modelagem financeira avançada;
  • Conhecimento de ferramentas de programação (Phyton, R, C++, outros) e IA inserida em todas as etapas do processo de investimento;
  • Conhecimento profundo dos marcos regulatórios e práticas contratuais dos setores de infraestrutura;
  • Inglês fluente (obrigatório)/Espanhol será considerado diferencial;
  • Forte capacidade de liderança, negociação e comunicação interpessoal;
  • Perfil estratégico, colaborativo, proativo e orientado a resultados, com visão de longo prazo e foco em criação de valor.

title: Manager - Accounting & Financial Statements (Financial Statement Review) - Rio de Janeiro or Sã[...]
description:
Overview

The Catalyst Group is a tech-focused financial services organization that is creating a spark in a one-dimensional industry. Founded in the Cayman Islands in 2020, Catalyst is a privately owned and fully independent group. We have offices and teams in 5 countries, servicing a global portfolio of clients with a wide range of strategies, structures, and requirements. Catalyst was founded with a clear mission to reimagine financial services by sparking innovation, harnessing technology, and investing in our people and our communities. In support of that mission, we have built an award-winning team of highly skilled, innovative, and client-centric individuals that are enabled with best-in-class technology to provide a platform that is unlike anything else in the industry. We do things differently. We do things better.

Catalyst is a values driven organization. We challenge our people to think and operate in accordance with a set of core values: Collaboration, Innovation, Reliability & Accountability, Connected Culture, Undivided Attention, Integrity, and Transparency. These values are part of our DNA; they are the principles that guide everything that we do.

Role Purpose

As the Manager of Financial Statement Review, you will lead a team dedicated to review, optimization, and support of financial statement preparation for fund clients and ad-hoc structures. Your responsibilities include ensuring high standards of service delivery, compliance with accounting standards (e.g., IFRS, US GAAP), and effective client management. This role emphasizes expertise in financial review, process improvement, technology utilization, cross-department collaboration, and innovation.

Responsibilities (high-level)

  • People Management Responsibilities.
  • Financial Statement Preparation and Management
  • Process Development and Technology Optimization
  • Operational Efficiency and Innovation:
  • Client Service and Support
  • Collaboration and Cross-Functional Integration
  • Risk and Compliance Responsibilities

Your Daily Tasks

1. People Management Responsibilities:

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:

  • a) Team Management - Manage the company’s global technology and product teams and ensure that all team members have relevant Job Descriptions that include Tasks and KPIs.
  • b) Day-to-day Team management – Managing the team on a day-to-day basis by implementing:
  • Weekly task management
  • Weekly team meetings

c)Team Satisfaction - Monitoring the team's capacity and ensuring high-level satisfaction and work-life balance.

d) Feedback and Coaching - Providing feedback and coaching to the team members with the aim of constantly improving their performance.

e) Team Training - Coordinating and providing training and development programs within the technology and product teams as or when required.

f) Team Succession planning - Identifying any high-potential and high-risk employees and developing the relevant succession plans.

2. Financial Statement Review and Oversight:

Includes (but not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Review and Quality Assurance: Conduct thorough reviews of financial statements prepared by the Financial Preparation team, ensuring accuracy, compliance with accounting standards, and high-quality presentation.

b) Process Accountability: Take ownership of the financial statement review cycle and be accountable for adherence to deadlines, service levels, and client expectations.

c) Complex Structures: Support and review the preparation of statements for complex fund structures, addressing intricate financial and regulatory requirements.

3. Process Development and Technology Optimization:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Process Improvement: Lead initiatives to enhance financial statement processes through automation and system integration, minimizing manual intervention and increasing operational efficiency.

b) System Utilization: Collaborate with technology and operations teams to optimize existing systems and identify new tools to streamline data transformation for financial statements.

c) Innovation Implementation: Drive the adoption of scalable processes, leveraging technology and best practices to ensure compliance and efficiency.

4. Operational Efficiency and Innovation:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Workflow Enhancement: Develop, implement, and refine workflows to support seamless financial statement review and improve productivity.

b) Scalability Focus: Identify opportunities to expand and scale financial statement support services to meet client needs and market demands.

c)New Solutions: Collaborate with product teams to design and introduce new services tailored to changing client needs and market conditions.

5. Client Service and Support:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Primary Point of Contact: Serve as the main point of contact for clients utilizing the Financial Statement Review Service, addressing their needs with professionalism and insight.

b) Client Engagement: Build and maintain client relationships, proactively managing expectations, service requests, and bespoke solutions.

c) Industry Adaptation: Stay abreast of industry trends, regulatory changes, and emerging practices to continuously adapt and enhance service offerings.

6. Collaboration and Cross-Functional Integration:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

  • Work cross-functionally with operations, business users, and project teams to deliver comprehensive and innovative solutions.
  • Drive process integration across service lines to ensure consistent, high-quality client service delivery and effective resource utilization.

7. Risk and Compliance Responsibilities:

Includes (but are not limited to) the following tasks:

a) Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory requirements, and jurisdictional changes affecting entities reporting under IFRS or US GAAP.

b) Act as the primary contact for all client interactions with external auditors, ensuring comprehensive, accurate, and timely responses.

c) Support new fund onboarding by ensuring smooth integration into financial statement workflows and compliance standards.

d) Policy Implementation: Help implement compliance policies at the operational level.

e) Monitoring Tools: Utilize tools to monitor compliance with internal controls and regulatory requirements.

f) Compliance Culture - Working in tandem with the groups Head of Compliance and Governance to instill a culture that is centered around good governance and compliance.

g) Reporting: Assist in preparing compliance reports for management review.

h) Issue Tracking: Track and manage compliance-related issues and follow up on resolutions.

i) Communication: Communicate compliance requirements effectively within the team.

Strategic Expectations

  • Share insights to enable development of new processes and procedures that will create business efficiency and support delivery of client excellence in service.
  • Maintain awareness of industry, regulatory, jurisdictional, and other trends that could affect the business.
  • Contribute to the creation, development and implementation of new products and solutions to accommodate the businesses continuous changing needs.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with operations staff, business users, project, and implementation managers to achieve desired and elegant solutions.

Required Skills & Experience

Are you getting excited? We are! Before we get too carried away, there are a few requirements you’ll need to check off before you can apply for the position:

  • Internationally recognized professional accounting designation (CPA, ACCA, CA).
  • Minimum 7 years’ post-qualification experience with a Big 4 accounting firm.
  • Experience in auditing or preparing financial statements for investment-related entities under US-GAAP and IFRS.
  • 5 years Fund accounting experience working with both Private Equity Funds and Hedge Funds.
  • Experience and knowledge of the digital accounting Funds space is preferable.
  • Knowledge of fund accounting software and expert use of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Power Query, Power Automate).
  • Proven track record of managing financial statement preparation teams and improving process efficiencies.
  • Familiarity with complex financial instruments and investment funds.
  • Experience serving a LATAM and US client base, particularly Brazilian clients.
  • CFA/CA designation completed or a willingness to complete.
  • Expertise with Geneva, Dynamo, Mantra, and other portfolio accounting systems.
